items.title: 〈美股盤後〉美股止血反彈！道瓊漲逾500點 但高殖利率陰霾揮之不去 三大指數周線全黑
paras: 美股週五 (21 日) 全面翻紅，道瓊勁揚逾 500 點，標普 500 指數與那斯達克指數同步上漲約 0.43%。金融、醫療與原物料股領漲，加密貨幣概念股也在比特幣強彈帶動下飆升。不過，美債殖利率持續攀高，三大指數本週仍全數收黑。
醫療股成為週五推升道瓊的主要動力，Merck (MRK-US)、嬌生 (JNJ-US) 走高。金融股同步反彈，KBW 銀行指數上漲近 1%，摩根士丹利 (MS-US) 與花旗 (C-US) 表現突出；原物料類股則上漲約 2%，領漲標普 500 各大類股。
儘管週五反彈，三大指數仍難逃單週收黑。標普本週下跌 1.4%，創 7 月 17 日以來最大單週跌幅；那指累計下跌 2%，兩者均終止連續三週上漲。道瓊本週下跌約 0.9%，連續第二週收黑。
比特幣週五一度漲破 7.9 萬美元，單週大漲 22%，創 2024 年 11 月以來最佳單週表現。加密貨幣概念股全面噴出，Robinhood (HOOD-US) 狂飆近 14%，成為標普週五表現最佳成分股。
市場認為，美國財政部加碼長天期公債回購，帶來流動性增加的期待，加上美國總統川普敦促國會通過加密市場結構法案《Clarity Act》，共同推升比特幣行情。
然而，財政部的救市措施仍未能壓低長債殖利率。10 年期美債殖利率週五升至 4.737%，30 年期殖利率攀上 5.276%，均逼近十多年高點。
美國財長貝森特此前表示，財政部擁有因應美債市場波動的「大型工具箱」，不排除進一步擴大目前每檔至少 40 億美元的長債回購規模，並預告政府將加強財政整頓。
不過，市場認為，回購措施主要只能改善債券市場的交易流動性，難以化解通膨疑慮、龐大財政赤字、債券供給增加及期限溢價攀升等根本問題。
油價走高也進一步加深市場對通膨的擔憂。布蘭特原油週五上漲 0.7%，收在每桶 94.39 美元，連續第六個交易日走高。
黃金則受惠於財政疑慮升溫，紐約期金本週大漲 5.6%，收在每盎司 4,624.10 美元，連續第三週上漲，三週累計漲幅超過 14%。
市場下週將迎來多項關鍵事件。貝森特預定下週一公布財政部債券回購與財政整頓措施的更多細節；輝達 (NVDA-US) 將於下週三盤後公布財報，市場焦點將落在 AI 晶片需求及其規模達 5,000 億美元的融資計畫。
聯準會主席華許則將於下週五在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會發表演說，投資人將從中尋找利率走向、通膨前景及央行獨立性的最新線索。
美股週五 (21 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭漲跌互見。Meta (META-US) 上漲 0.75%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下跌 0.63%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 上漲 1.22%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 上漲 0.43%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 0.57%。
費城半導體族群互有消長。AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 0.81%；博通 (AVGO-US) 上漲 1.21%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 下跌 0.98%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 下跌 0.78%；高通 (QCOM-US) 微漲 0.01%；美光 (MU-US) 下跌 0.77%。
記憶體類股普遍收墨。美光 (MU-US) 跌 0.77%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 下滑 2.05%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 下跌 0.28%；希捷科技 (STX-US) 微跌 0.03%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 漲 0.20%。
台股 ADR 漲多跌少。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 微升 0.71%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 收平；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 1.89%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 微漲 0.05%。
企業新聞
莫德納 (MRNA-US) 漲幅高近 8.9% 至每股 145.13 美元，為標普週五表現第二佳成分股，合作夥伴Merck (MRK-US) 同步上漲超 2% 至每股 152.55 美元。莫德納本週稍早公布與Merck共同研發的個人化癌症疫苗取得正面試驗結果，股價一度飆升近 180%，週四隨後重挫 24%，週五則出現反彈。
特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 走高 5.14% 至每股362.86美元。該公司宣布，將在 9 月中旬於德國登場的 IAA Transportation 商用車展上，發表面向歐洲市場的純電動 Semi 卡車。
SpaceX (SPCX-US) 上漲 2.2%，收在每股 136.97 美元，未受第二波限售股解禁及華爾街首份「賣出」評級拖累。SpaceX 於 8 月 20 日迎來上市滿 70 天的階梯式解禁，此次釋出最多約 3.19 億股，同時，DZ Bank 以資本需求龐大、估值過高且存在「崩跌風險」為由，給予該股「賣出」評級及 100 美元目標價。
Marvell (MRVL-US) 重挫 5.57% 至每股 237.04 美元，成為標普最差成分股，但全週仍累計上漲逾 6%。Marvell 週三宣布向 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 旗下 Google 發行認股權證，Google 最多可購入 5,897 萬股 Marvell 普通股，相關持股價值最高可達 121.9 億美元。
阿里巴巴 ADR (BABA-US) 下殺 8.6% 至每股119.34 美元，回吐前一交易日漲幅。阿里巴巴公布的財報未達市場預期，儘管 AI 業務營收大幅成長，仍未能消除投資人對整體業績的疑慮。
華爾街分析
Verdence Capital Advisors創辦人暨執行長Leo Kelly警告，若美債殖利率持續攀升，加上中東緊張局勢延續，美股今年秋季可能進一步下跌，甚至進入修正區間。
Kelly表示，市場目前已適應10年期美債殖利率落在4%至5%，但若受到突發事件刺激，殖利率突破至6%至7%，情況就會變得棘手，股市也將做出負面反應。
Bernstein 分析師認為，美財政部擴大買回長期公債，可望增加市場資金並改善流動性，促使部分資金流入比特幣，成為本週幣價大漲的主要推力。過去經驗顯示，市場資金越充裕，比特幣通常越容易上漲。
不過，Muriel Siebert投資長Mark Malek指出，美債殖利率短暫回落後迅速反彈，顯示投資人更關注高殖利率背後的根本問題，而非財政部的回購操作。通膨前景不明、龐大財政赤字、公債供給增加及期限溢價上升，均難以單靠市場操作化解。
Plurimi Wealth投資長Patrick Armstrong則研判，貝森特試圖壓低長期殖利率的做法可能已產生反效果，迫使財政部採取更多行動。他直言，每當政府試圖控制30年期美債殖利率時，最後通常仍是市場占上風，除非由擁有龐大資產負債表的聯準會親自出手。
美銀策略師Michael Hartnett表示，如果財政部回購計畫無法壓低殖利率，美元可能承受壓力，投資人也可能在11月期中選舉前加碼放空風險資產，其中包括AI超大規模雲端服務商。高盛策略師也指出，避險基金已開始降低對波動劇烈的AI交易依賴，轉向其他投資領域。
數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主

items.title: 美國債務危機最快一年後爆發？達里歐喊賣債券、買黃金
items.title_en: US Debt Crisis Could Erupt as Soon as One Year? Dalio Urges Selling Bonds and Buying Gold
paras: 橋水基金創辦人、億萬富豪投資人達里歐(Ray Dalio)警告，美國債務危機最快可能在未來數年內爆發，投資人應降低債券配置，並將約10%至15%的投資組合配置於黃金，另外持有「少量」比特幣，以分散貨幣貶值與通膨風險。
達里歐周五(21日)在LinkedIn發文表示，投資人應分散投資於不同資產及財政狀況穩健的國家。他認為，減持債券並增加黃金與比特幣部位，不僅可能降低整體風險，也有機會提高投資報酬。
達里歐長期警告政府債務持續膨脹的危險。近期長天期美債殖利率升至多年高點，美國最大海外債權國日本也出售美債以支撐日元。為遏止債市賣壓，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)本周宣布擴大長天期美債回購，但目前僅帶來短暫支撐。
達里歐表示，近期發展符合他在《國家如何破產 大週期》(How Countries Go Broke: The Big Cycle)一書提出的債務循環架構。隨著政府償債成本上升，最終可能遭遇投資人需求不足，屆時政府只能接受更高利率，或由央行創造貨幣購買公債，代價則是貨幣貶值與通膨升溫。
他估計，美國政府今年收入約5.5兆美元，支出則達7.5兆美元，留下約2兆美元缺口。光是利息支出就接近1兆美元，另有約10兆美元債務需要再融資。
若政策方向不變，達里歐預測美國債務危機可能在「三年左右、上下相差兩年」內出現，換言之，風險期可能落在未來一至五年。他主張透過削減支出、增加稅收及降低利率，把目前約占國內生產毛額(GDP)6%的財政赤字降至3%。
達里歐指出，英國、中國與日本也面臨類似財政壓力，因此看好不由政府發行的貨幣型資產，包括黃金與比特幣。黃金周五升至5月以來最高，比特幣則突破7.7萬美元，可望寫下2023年以來最大單周漲幅。
paras_en: Bridgewater founder and billionaire investor Ray Dalio warned that a US debt crisis could materialize within the next few years, urging investors to cut bond exposure and allocate about 10%‑15% of their portfolios to gold, while holding a "small" amount of Bitcoin to hedge currency depreciation and inflation risk.

Dalio posted on LinkedIn on Friday (the 21st) that investors should diversify across assets and countries with sound fiscal positions. He believes reducing bond holdings and increasing positions in gold and Bitcoin could not only lower overall risk but also potentially boost returns.

Dalio has long warned about the danger of ever‑growing government debt. Recently, long‑term US Treasury yields have risen to multi‑year highs and Japan, the United States’ biggest overseas creditor, has been selling US debt to support the yen. To curb selling pressure in the bond market, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced an expansion of long‑term Treasury buybacks this week, which so far has provided only a brief lift.

Dalio said the latest developments fit the debt‑cycle framework he outlined in his book *How Countries Go Broke: The Big Cycle*. As government debt‑service costs rise, demand from investors may dry up, forcing governments to accept higher rates or rely on central banks to create money to buy sovereign bonds, at the cost of currency depreciation and higher inflation.

He estimates that the US government will collect roughly $5.5 trillion in revenue this year against $7.5 trillion in spending, leaving a gap of about $2 trillion. Interest payments alone approach $1 trillion, and about $10 trillion of debt will need to be refinanced.

If policy remains unchanged, Dalio predicts a US debt crisis could emerge in "around three years, give or take two years," meaning the risk window could fall within the next one to five years. He advocates cutting expenditures, raising taxes and lowering rates to bring the fiscal deficit, currently about 6% of GDP, down to roughly 3%.

Dalio noted that the UK, China and Japan face similar fiscal pressures, so he is bullish on currency‑type assets not issued by governments, such as gold and Bitcoin. Gold rose on Friday to its highest level since May, and Bitcoin broke the $77,000 mark, poised for its biggest weekly gain since 2023.

items.title: 長江存儲母公司申請上海科創板IPO 擬籌資49億美元
items.title_en: Yangtze Memory Holdings Parent Applies for Shanghai STAR Market IPO, Aiming to Raise $4.9 Billion
paras: 綜合外媒周五(21日)報導，中國NAND快閃記憶體大廠長江存儲(YMTC)的母公司長江存儲控股股份有限公司(CCSH Corporation,CCSH)，計劃透過上海科創板首次公開募股(IPO)籌資人民幣330億元(約49億美元)，上市申請已獲上海證券交易所受理。若順利完成，將成為科創板史上第三大IPO，僅次於長鑫存儲(CXMT)與中芯國際(00981-HK)。
根據招股書，CCSH預計發行19.8億至24.3億股新股，上市後估值約2,750億至3,300億元人民幣(約410億至490億美元)。中信證券與中信建投擔任共同保薦機構。
CCSH是此次上市主體，旗下全資子公司YMTC則是集團主要營運業務，貢獻超過90%營收。YMTC生產NAND快閃記憶體，廣泛應用於智慧型手機、固態硬碟、資料中心及企業伺服器。
公司表示，AI大規模應用正帶動龐大且長期的資料儲存需求，上市有助擴充先進產能、強化研發，並確保中國及全球市場供應穩定。330億元人民幣募資中，208億元將用於升級生產線，122億元投入新一代NAND晶片及高速儲存產品研發。
受惠雲端服務業者大舉興建AI資料中心，以及全球記憶體供應吃緊，YMTC業績快速成長。2026年第一季營收達470億元人民幣，接近去年同期的5倍；歸屬股東淨利達333.8億元，超越2025年全年142.1億元的兩倍。
YMTC工廠目前接近滿載，第一季NAND平均售價較2025年平均水準高出173%，毛利率也由去年的35.3%升至76.8%。公司引述TrendForce資料表示，第一季以銷售額與出貨量計算，YMTC已成為全球第三大、中國第一大NAND供應商。
YMTC的競爭對手包括三星電子、SK海力士(SKHY-US)、美光(MU-US)、鎧俠及SanDisk(SNDK-US)。在AI需求與供應吃緊支撐下，YMTC與CXMT的議價能力增強，部分產品對中國客戶的報價甚至高於南韓競爭對手。
不過，CCSH也警告地緣政治、出口管制及供應鏈中斷等風險。YMTC已於2022年被美國商務部列入實體清單，並被五角大廈列為中國軍事企業。為降低限制衝擊，公司正擴大採用中國製設備，並開發利用較舊製程工具的生產技術。
paras_en: According to foreign media reports on Friday (the 21st), Yangtze Memory Technologies Co. (YMTC), a major Chinese NAND flash memory manufacturer, plans to raise 33 billion yuan (about $4.9 billion) through an initial public offering on Shanghai’s STAR Market. The listing application has been accepted by the Shanghai Stock Exchange. If completed, it would become the third‑largest IPO in STAR Market history, behind CXMT and SMIC (00981‑HK).

The prospectus states that CCSH intends to issue between 1.98 billion and 2.43 billion new shares, valuing the company at roughly 275 billion to 330 billion yuan (about $41 billion to $49 billion) after listing. CITIC Securities and CITIC Construction Investment act as joint sponsors.

CCSH is the listed entity, while its wholly‑owned subsidiary YMTC conducts the group’s core operations, contributing more than 90 % of revenue. YMTC manufactures NAND flash memory used widely in smartphones, solid‑state drives, data centers and enterprise servers.

The company says massive, long‑term data‑storage demand driven by large‑scale AI applications underpins the IPO, which will help expand advanced capacity, strengthen R&D, and ensure stable supply for China and global markets. Of the 33 billion yuan raised, 20.8 billion will fund production‑line upgrades and 12.2 billion will be invested in next‑generation NAND chips and high‑speed storage product development.

Benefiting from cloud providers building AI data centers and tight global memory supply, YMTC’s performance has surged. In Q1 2026, revenue reached 47 billion yuan, nearly five times the same period last year, and net profit attributable to shareholders hit 33.38 billion yuan, more than double the full‑year 2025 figure of 14.21 billion yuan.

YMTC’s factory is now close to full capacity; the average NAND selling price in Q1 was 173 % higher than the 2025 average, and gross margin rose from 35.3 % last year to 76.8 %. Citing TrendForce data, the company says that based on sales and shipments in Q1, YMTC became the world’s third‑largest and China’s largest NAND supplier.

YMTC’s competitors include Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix (SKHY‑US), Micron (MU‑US), Kioxia and SanDisk (SNDK‑US). With AI demand and supply constraints, YMTC and CXMT have gained bargaining power, with some product quotes to Chinese customers even exceeding those of South Korean rivals.

However, CCSH warns of geopolitical risks, export controls and supply‑chain disruptions. YMTC was placed on the U.S. Commerce Department’s Entity List in 2022 and designated by the Pentagon as a Chinese military‑linked company. To mitigate restrictions, the firm is expanding the use of domestically‑made equipment and developing production techniques that rely on older‑process tools.

items.title: AI晶片不只拚效能！博通籌800億美元 與輝達展開資本軍備競賽
items.title_en: Broadcom Seeks $80 Billion Funding, Sparring with Nvidia in Capital Arms Race for AI Chips
paras: 博通(AVGO-US)正洽談籌措700億至800億美元債務資金，用於一項支援Anthropic等人工智慧(AI)公司的晶片融資計畫，顯示AI基礎設施建設所需資本規模持續膨脹。
《CNBC》記者David Faber日前證實，這筆融資預計分成高順位與低順位兩部分。可優先獲得償付的高順位債務規模約為450億美元，承擔較高風險的低順位債務則約為350億美元。不過，知情人士表示，最終金額仍可能調整。
《彭博》率先報導這項交易，並指出整體融資規模最高可能達到1,000億美元。黑石集團(BX-US)與阿波羅全球管理(APO-US)等投資機構，正在洽談參與這項大型融資案。
隨著AI模型規模擴大及運算工作負載增加，晶片製造商正尋求史無前例的資金，協助客戶興建資料中心、採購晶片並擴充運算能力。融資已逐漸成為晶片商爭取大型AI客戶及支撐未來訂單的重要工具。
博通今年6月宣布推出新的AI平台，計畫為Anthropic與OpenAI提供總計20吉瓦(GW)的運算能力。黑石與阿波羅當時主導首階段350億美元融資，此次洽談中的新交易則可能進一步擴大相關資金規模。
博通的融資布局也反映AI晶片產業的競爭已從產品效能延伸至資本支援。輝達(NVDA-US)本周在監管文件中表示，將提供最高1,050億美元資金，支持OpenAI在美國俄亥俄州興建新資料中心。
此前一周，輝達也宣布與六家大型資產管理公司合作，推動規模達5,000億美元的融資計畫，希望將AI運算基礎設施發展成新的資產類別。
在大型科技公司競相投入AI資料中心之際，博通若成功完成最高800億美元融資，將進一步提高其在AI晶片與基礎設施市場的競爭力。博通股價周五上漲逾1%。
paras_en: Broadcom (AVGO-US) is in talks to raise $70 billion to $80 billion in debt financing for a chip‑funding program that supports AI companies such as Anthropic, underscoring the ever‑growing capital needs of AI infrastructure construction.

CNBC reporter David Faber confirmed that the financing is expected to be split into senior and junior tranches. The senior debt, which would be repaid first, is about $45 billion, while the riskier junior debt is roughly $35 billion, though sources say the final amounts could still be adjusted.

Bloomberg broke the story, noting that the total financing could top $100 billion. Investment firms including Blackstone (BX-US) and Apollo Global Management (APO-US) are in discussions to take part in the massive deal.

As AI models grow larger and computational workloads increase, chip makers are seeking unprecedented funding to help customers build data centers, purchase chips and expand compute capacity. Financing is becoming a key tool for chip firms to win large AI customers and support future orders.

Broadcom announced in June that it would launch a new AI platform, planning to provide a total of 20 GW of compute power to Anthropic and OpenAI. Blackstone and Apollo led the initial $35 billion financing round, and the new deal under negotiation could further expand that pool of capital.

Broadcom’s financing strategy also reflects that competition in the AI‑chip industry has moved beyond product performance to capital support. Nvidia (NVDA-US) this week disclosed in regulatory filings that it will provide up to $105 billion in funding to back OpenAI’s new data center in Ohio, USA.
A week earlier, Nvidia announced a partnership with six large asset‑management firms to launch a $500 billion financing program, aiming to turn AI compute infrastructure into a new asset class.

With major tech firms racing to pour money into AI data centers, if Broadcom successfully completes a financing of up to $80 billion, it will further boost its competitiveness in the AI‑chip and infrastructure market. Broadcom’s shares rose more than 1 % on Friday.

items.title: 貝森特愈來愈像川普！美債市場的耐心快沒了
items.title_en: Bessent Is Becoming More Like Trump! Patience in the U.S. Bond Market Is Running Out
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)曾表示，自己的職責是擔任美國公債市場的「首要守護者」。然而，一篇評論指出，財長真正的權力與價值來自金融市場，尤其是美債市場對他的信任，而貝森特恐怕難以長期同時維持市場信譽，又滿足總統川普的政治需求。
隨著經濟目標逐漸偏離現實，貝森特近期不僅更頻繁為川普政策辯護，說話方式也愈來愈像川普。這可能侵蝕財長最重要的資產，也就是在投資人眼中的可信度。

財長最重要的資產是市場信任

評論作者回憶，自己曾於2008年至2009年金融危機期間在財政部任職，首次參加時任財長鮑爾森(Hank Paulson)主持的高階主管會議，是在貝爾斯登倒閉一周後。當時金融市場正處於近百年來最混亂的時刻之一。
作者指出，鮑爾森主持會議時，幾乎無法從發言辨別哪些人是政治任命官員，哪些人是常任文官。當一名官員試圖為住房可負擔修正計畫成效不彰進行政治包裝時，鮑爾森立即打斷對方，強調政治訊息可以稍後再談，當務之急是找出改善政策的方法。
鮑爾森並非毫無缺點，也帶有前高盛執行長特有的自信與偏見，但他大致成功維持市場信任，關鍵在於盡量避開黨派政治，並坦白向政府與公眾說明當時金融體系面臨的危險處境。
貝森特上任時同樣抱持遠大目標，提出所謂「3-3-3計畫」，希望將美國國內生產毛額(GDP)成長率推升至3%、把財政赤字降至GDP的3%，並讓國內石油日產量增加300萬桶。
他還主張將10年期美債殖利率壓低至3%，認為相較於聯準會(Fed)的聯邦基金利率，10年期殖利率對一般美國民眾的房貸及其他借貸成本更為重要。

三個三計畫逐漸偏離現實

然而，評論指出，貝森特和許多前任官員一樣，上任後才發現公共服務往往無法按照個人議程推進，而是必須不斷處理由外部事件引發的危機。貝森特面對的挑戰包括川普「解放日」關稅、伊朗戰爭，以及美國公債市場接連遭到拋售。
目前最新GDP年化成長率僅1.5%，財政赤字反而升至GDP的5.8%，石油日產量也只增加35萬桶，遠低於300萬桶目標。10年期美債殖利率則升至4.7%，甚至高於川普就職當天水準。
面對這些落差，貝森特並未向市場坦承政策目標面臨的困難，反而愈來愈採用川普式的政治語言。他多次否認關稅會推高通膨，並把相關批評稱為「關稅精神錯亂症」。
貝森特5月舉行記者會時，也曾把記者對生活成本上升及家庭儲蓄率下滑的擔憂，斥為過度悲觀的觀點。他當時預測財政赤字不久後將下降，並宣稱美伊協議即將達成，通膨與汽油價格也會隨之回落，但將近三個月後，相關協議仍未出現明顯進展。
儘管如此，貝森特近期仍進一步升高對伊朗的強硬措辭。他接受Newsmax訪問時表示，美國已從軍事上的「史詩怒火」轉向「經濟怒火」，將採取史無前例的措施孤立伊朗。他也開始在社群媒體與記者公開爭論，風格愈來愈接近川普。
人事動盪同樣加深外界疑慮。據新聞網站Notus報導，貝森特麾下16名經參議院確認的官員已有7人離職，幕僚長至少更換三次。雖然川普第二任政府整體人員流動率本就偏高，但財政部接連流失高階官員，仍可能影響政策執行與內部穩定。

迎合川普恐讓貝森特失去債市

評論認為，貝森特從來不會是一位傳統型財長，就像川普並非傳統型總統。貝森特表現最好時，仍像一名擅長掌握市場機會的總體經濟交易員，例如近期干預匯市以支撐日元，以及將每次長天期美債回購規模提高一倍至40億美元。
然而，在最糟的情況下，他看起來更像替政府政策宣傳的政治代理人，甚至成為一名主導金融戰爭的財政部長，與國防部長赫格塞斯(Pete Hegseth)分別掌管經濟與軍事戰線。
目前貝森特的職位仍相對安全，原因是川普往往以主要股價指數衡量經濟表現，而受到AI相關投資推動，美股持續改寫歷史高點。但股市創高，不代表美債投資人會無限期接受他的政策。
30年期美債殖利率本周升至2007年以來高點，顯示投資人的耐心正在消退。財政部雖可透過回購及調整發債結構短暫影響市場，卻難以消除財政赤字、通膨與政策不確定性帶來的長期壓力。
評論警告，隨著債市持續考驗貝森特，而他為了維持川普信任又不斷模仿總統的政治語言，市場可能愈來愈質疑他是否仍會優先維護財政紀律與美債市場穩定。
貝森特面臨的真正兩難，不只是如何壓低殖利率，而是能否在忠於川普與忠於市場現實之間維持平衡。一旦為了保住政治地位而犧牲市場信任，他失去的將是財長最重要、也最難重新建立的信用。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has said his job is to serve as the "primary guardian" of the U.S. Treasury market. However, a commentary notes that the secretary’s real power and value come from the financial markets, especially the bond market’s trust in him, and Bessent may find it difficult to maintain market credibility over the long term while also satisfying President Trump’s political demands.

As economic targets drift further from reality, Bessent has lately defended Trump’s policies more frequently and his speaking style is increasingly reminiscent of Trump’s. This could erode the secretary’s most important asset – his credibility in the eyes of investors.

The secretary’s most important asset is market trust. The commentary’s author recalls working at the Treasury during the 2008‑2009 financial crisis and attending a senior‑official meeting chaired by then‑Treasury Secretary Hank Paulson a week after the collapse of Bear Stearns. At that time the financial markets were experiencing one of the most chaotic periods in a century.

The author points out that when Paulson chaired the meeting, it was almost impossible to tell from the speakers who were political appointees and who were career civil servants. When an official tried to spin the weak performance of the affordable‑housing repair program as a political success, Paulson cut him off immediately, stressing that political messaging could wait – the priority was to find ways to improve the policy.

Paulson was not without flaws and carried the confidence and bias typical of a former Goldman Sachs CEO, but he largely succeeded in preserving market trust by steering clear of partisan politics and being frank with the government and the public about the dangerous state of the financial system at the time.

When Bessent took office he also set ambitious goals, unveiling a so‑called "3‑3‑3 plan" that aimed to raise U.S. GDP growth to 3%, cut the fiscal deficit to 3% of GDP, and increase domestic oil production by 3 million barrels per day.

He also advocated pushing the 10‑year Treasury yield down to 3%, arguing that, compared with the Federal Reserve’s federal funds rate, the 10‑year yield matters more to ordinary Americans’ mortgage and other borrowing costs.

The three‑three‑three plan drifts further from reality. The commentary notes that, like many of his predecessors, Bessent discovered after taking office that public services rarely move forward according to a personal agenda and instead require constant crisis management triggered by external events. His challenges include Trump’s “day of liberation” tariffs, the war with Iran, and a series of sell‑offs in the U.S. Treasury market.

The latest annualized GDP growth is only 1.5%, the fiscal deficit has risen to 5.8% of GDP, and oil production has increased by just 350,000 barrels per day – far short of the 3 million‑barrel target. The 10‑year Treasury yield has climbed to 4.7%, even higher than the level on Trump’s inauguration day.

Facing these gaps, Bessent has not admitted to the market that the policy goals are difficult to achieve; instead he has increasingly adopted Trump‑style political rhetoric. He repeatedly denied that tariffs would push up inflation and dismissed related criticism as "tariff‑spirit psychosis."

At a press conference in May, Bessent brushed off reporters’ concerns about rising living costs and falling household savings rates as overly pessimistic. He predicted the fiscal deficit would soon decline, claimed a U.S.–Iran agreement was imminent, and said inflation and gasoline prices would fall accordingly – yet almost three months later the agreement showed no clear progress.

Nevertheless, Bessent has recently escalated his hard‑line language toward Iran. In a Newsmax interview he said the United States has shifted from an "epic fire of war" to an "economic fire" and will take unprecedented measures to isolate Iran. He has also begun publicly debating journalists on social media, with a style that increasingly mirrors Trump’s.

Personnel turmoil has deepened external doubts. According to the news site Notus, seven of the 16 Senate‑confirmed officials under Bessent have left, and the chief of staff has been replaced at least three times. While turnover was already high in Trump’s second administration, the Treasury’s loss of senior staff could still affect policy implementation and internal stability.

Catering to Trump may cost Bessent the bond market. The commentary argues that Bessent will never be a traditional treasury secretary, just as Trump is not a traditional president. At his best, Bessent resembles a macro‑economics trader who knows how to seize market opportunities, such as recent interventions in the foreign‑exchange market to support the yen and doubling each long‑term Treasury repurchase operation to $40 billion.

In the worst case, however, he looks more like a political propagandist for government policy, even becoming a finance minister who leads a financial war, while Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth runs the military front.

Bessent’s position remains relatively safe for now because Trump tends to judge economic performance by major stock‑price indices, and AI‑driven investment has kept U.S. equities climbing to new highs. But a soaring stock market does not mean Treasury investors will indefinitely accept his policies.

The 30‑year Treasury yield rose this week to its highest level since 2007, indicating that investors’ patience is waning. The Treasury can temporarily influence the market through repurchases and adjustments to issuance structure, but it cannot eliminate the long‑term pressure from deficits, inflation and policy uncertainty.

The commentary warns that as the bond market continues to test Bessent, and he keeps mimicking the president’s political language to retain Trump’s trust, the market may increasingly doubt whether he will still prioritize fiscal discipline and Treasury market stability.

Bessent’s real dilemma is not just how to push yields lower, but whether he can balance loyalty to Trump with loyalty to market reality. If he sacrifices market trust to preserve his political standing, he will lose the most important, and hardest‑to‑regain, component of a treasury secretary’s credibility.

items.title: 美股還能再漲6%！瑞銀喊標普500年底攻上8100點
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Could Rise Another 6% — UBS Raises S&P 500 Year‑End Target to 8,100 Points
paras: 瑞銀集團(UBS-US)旗下瑞銀全球財富管理(UBS Global Wealth Management)上調標普500指數目標，預估該指數今年底將升至8,100點，理由是企業獲利前景增強，且明年利潤可望持續成長。
最新目標較標普500指數周四收盤的7,641.16點高出約6%。瑞銀也將2027年年中目標由8,200點調升至8,400點，成為愈來愈多預測標普500指數將在2026年底突破8,000點的全球研究機構之一。
瑞銀維持對美股「具吸引力」的看法，並表示支撐這波多頭市場的三大支柱仍然穩固，包括經濟成長展現韌性、貨幣政策提供支持，以及人工智慧(AI)加速普及。
瑞銀指出，AI相關企業仍是推動市場上漲的重要力量，但近期行情也受到經濟中景氣循環產業條件改善的支撐，顯示漲勢正逐步擴展至科技股以外的領域。
隨著企業獲利展望轉強，瑞銀將標普500指數2026年每股盈餘(EPS)預估由335美元上調至350美元，2027年預估則由375美元提高至400美元。
這項調整顯示，瑞銀認為美股即使已處於高檔，仍有進一步上漲空間。只要經濟維持成長、政策環境保持有利，且AI投資繼續轉化為企業獲利，標普500指數年底仍可能挑戰8,100點。
paras_en: UBS Group (UBS‑US) through its UBS Global Wealth Management unit raised its S&P 500 target, forecasting the index will climb to 8,100 points by year‑end, citing stronger corporate earnings outlooks and the expectation of continued profit growth into next year.

The new target is about 6% higher than the S&P 500’s Thursday close of 7,641.16 points. UBS also lifted its mid‑2027 target from 8,200 to 8,400 points, joining an increasing number of global research firms that see the index breaking the 8,000‑point mark by the end of 2026.

UBS maintained its view that U.S. equities remain attractive, noting that the three main pillars supporting the current bull market remain solid: resilient economic growth, supportive monetary policy, and the accelerating adoption of artificial intelligence (AI).

The bank highlighted that AI‑related companies continue to be a key driver of market gains, but recent rallies have also been bolstered by improving conditions in cyclical sectors, indicating that the uptrend is extending beyond tech stocks.
With corporate profit outlooks strengthening, UBS raised its 2026 S&P 500 earnings‑per‑share (EPS) estimate from $335 to $350 and its 2027 estimate from $375 to $400.

The adjustment shows UBS believes the U.S. market, even at elevated levels, still has upside. As long as the economy keeps growing, policy conditions stay favorable, and AI investments keep translating into corporate profits, the S&P 500 could still challenge the 8,100‑point mark by year‑end.

items.title: 演算法停權惹禍！荷蘭認定Uber侵犯駕駛權益 重罰9.66億美元
items.title_en: Algorithmic Bans Cause Trouble! Netherlands Finds Uber Violated Drivers' Rights, Fines €825 million (≈$966 million)
paras: 荷蘭資料保護局(AP)認定，叫車平台Uber(UBER-US)在未充分告知駕駛的情況下，透過自動化系統停用其帳號，違反歐洲《一般資料保護規則》(GDPR)，決定對公司開罰8.25億歐元(約9.66億美元)。Uber不服裁決，表示將提出上訴。
根據《路透》看到的8月17日裁決文件，這將是GDPR上路以來第二高額罰款，僅次於愛爾蘭監管機關2023年對Meta(META-US)開出的12億歐元罰款。Meta當時因非法將歐洲Facebook用戶資料傳送至美國遭到處分，目前也在上訴。
GDPR禁止企業完全依靠電腦演算法，作出對個人生活具有重大影響的決定，相關程序必須納入具有實質意義的人工審查，並提供當事人提出異議的管道。
荷蘭資料保護局表示，Uber侵犯駕駛不受重大自動化決策影響的權利，同時未盡到充分告知義務。監管機關認為違規情節嚴重，因此決定開出高額罰款。
此案涉及2020至2022年發生在歐洲的事件，最初源自法國提出的申訴。由於Uber歐洲總部位於荷蘭，因此案件交由荷蘭資料保護局處理。
Uber的系統曾暫時停用部分涉嫌詐欺的駕駛帳號，例如系統判定駕駛刻意繞路以墊高車資，或接單後並無完成行程的意圖。荷蘭資料保護局也指稱，部分顧客評分偏低的駕駛曾遭電腦系統永久停權。
Uber否認曾以自動化方式永久停用駕駛帳號，強調相關暫停措施通常時間短暫，永久停權前一定會經過人工審查。公司發言人表示，Uber高度重視駕駛權益，目前政策也包含人工複核及申訴機制。
Uber批評裁決內容與罰款金額不成比例，並指出受影響人數相當有限，2021年歐洲僅有126名駕駛因顧客評分偏低遭停權。
近年歐洲監管機關依據隱私、競爭及數位市場規範，對Meta、Google(GOOGL-US)、蘋果(AAPL-US)及亞馬遜(AMZN-US)等美國科技巨頭開出數十億歐元罰款，但不少處分在多年上訴後遭到調降或撤銷。美國總統川普也曾批評相關罰款，美國國務院高層4月更將其形容為美歐經濟關係「最大的單一摩擦來源」。
paras_en: The Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) has determined that ride‑hailing platform Uber (UBER‑US) disabled drivers' accounts via an automated system without adequately informing the drivers, violating the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). The regulator has imposed a fine of €825 million (about $966 million) on the company. Uber disagrees with the ruling and says it will appeal.

According to a decision document seen by Reuters dated August 17, this is the second‑largest GDPR fine ever imposed, second only to the €1.2 billion penalty levied by Irish regulators on Meta (META‑US) in 2023 for illegally transferring European Facebook user data to the United States. Meta is also appealing that fine.

The GDPR prohibits companies from making decisions that have a significant impact on individuals' lives solely by computer algorithms; such processes must include substantive human review and provide a way for affected persons to lodge objections.

The Dutch authority said Uber infringed drivers' rights not to be subject to major automated decisions and also failed to provide sufficient notice. The regulator deemed the breach serious enough to warrant a hefty fine.

The case concerns incidents that occurred in Europe between 2020 and 2022 and originated from a complaint filed in France. Because Uber’s European headquarters are in the Netherlands, the matter was handled by the Dutch Data Protection Authority.

Uber’s system had temporarily disabled some driver accounts suspected of fraud, such as when the system judged a driver of deliberately taking longer routes to inflate fares or accepting rides without intending to complete them. The Dutch authority also alleged that drivers with consistently low customer ratings were permanently banned by the computer system.

Uber denies that it ever permanently disabled driver accounts automatically, stressing that any suspensions are usually brief and that permanent bans are always preceded by human review. A company spokesperson said Uber places a high priority on driver rights and that its policies now include manual re‑checks and an appeals mechanism.

Uber criticized the decision as disproportionate to the fine amount and pointed out that the number of affected drivers was relatively small—only 126 drivers in Europe were suspended in 2021 due to low customer ratings.

In recent years European regulators, invoking privacy, competition and digital market rules, have levied billions of euros in fines on U.S. tech giants such as Meta, Google (GOOGL‑US), Apple (AAPL‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US). Many of those penalties have been reduced or overturned after lengthy appeals. Former U.S. President Trump also criticized the fines, and senior U.S. State Department officials in April described them as the "largest single source of friction" in U.S.–EU economic relations.

items.title: 衰退擔憂降溫！美國8月商業活動創逾四年最快 Q3經濟成長率上看3%
items.title_en: Recession Fears Cool! US August Business Activity Hits Fastest Pace in Over Four Years, Q3 Growth Seen Near 3%
paras: 美國8月商業活動意外加速，服務業強勁成長抵銷製造業降溫，帶動整體產出擴張速度創逾四年新高。企業信心與招聘活動同步回升，顯示美國第三季經濟成長率可能接近3%，約為第二季的兩倍。不過，中東戰事造成的供應鏈中斷與能源價格風險，仍是企業面臨的主要威脅。
根據標普全球(S&P Global)周五(21日)公布的初值，8月美國綜合採購經理人指數(PMI)由7月的54.5升至56.0，創2022年4月以來最高。PMI高於50代表經濟活動擴張，低於50則表示萎縮。
標普全球市場財智首席商業經濟學家Chris Williamson表示，美國企業活動正在蓬勃發展，第三季迄今產出成長速度為逾四年最快，且8月擴張動能進一步增強。

服務業意外加速撐起第三季成長

8月服務業PMI由7月的54.6大幅升至56.8，創20個月新高，遠優於《路透》調查經濟學家預估的54.0。市場原本預期，隨著世界盃相關消費及美國獨立250周年慶祝活動等一次性因素消退，服務業成長將有所放緩，結果實際表現反而加速。
服務業新業務成長速度創2024年12月以來最快，帶動相關企業招聘增幅升至19個月新高。整體而言，美國企業8月增聘人力的速度為2025年1月以來最快，製造業與服務業均擴大招聘，但服務業表現尤其強勁。
標普全球指出，目前第三季調查數據顯示，美國經濟年化成長率有望接近3%，較第二季的1.5%明顯加速。這也顯示美國經濟成長動能已由第二季的製造業逐漸轉向服務業，對消費支出及金融服務成長的依賴程度隨之提高。
Williamson表示，隨著企業對關稅及中東衝突負面影響的擔憂減退，雇主信心有所改善。衡量企業未來產出預期的指標也攀升至九個月高點，反映企業對後續營運前景轉趨樂觀。

供應鏈干擾拖累製造業表現

相較之下，8月製造業PMI由7月的53.9降至53.2，創五個月新低，也低於市場預期的53.9，但仍維持在擴張區間。原料短缺、供應鏈延誤及企業減少建立安全庫存，均限制工廠生產。
伊朗戰爭導致荷姆茲海峽實質封閉，干擾重要大宗商品供應並推高能源價格。企業在戰爭爆發後一度積極增加庫存，帶動訂單快速上升，但隨著安全庫存需求減弱，8月訂單成長已連續第四個月放緩，工廠產出增速也降至13個月最低。
調查顯示，8月供應延誤程度仍接近過去四年最嚴重水準之一，明顯限制許多企業提高產量。Williamson指出，中東局勢仍是企業的重要憂慮，尤其是戰事對供應路線與能源價格的衝擊。
另一方面，企業成本壓力在8月有所緩解，投入成本增幅為伊朗戰爭爆發以來最慢，但投入價格與銷售價格漲幅仍處於高檔。第三季迄今平均成本增幅仍略高於第二季，意味通膨風險尚未消失。
Williamson警告，目前價格壓力雖逐漸減弱，但仍可能因能源價格再次上漲而迅速升溫。美國經濟展現比預期更強的韌性之際，後續能否維持接近3%的成長速度，仍取決於服務業需求能否延續，以及中東戰事與供應鏈瓶頸是否進一步惡化。
paras_en: US August business activity unexpectedly accelerated, with strong service‑sector growth offsetting a cooling manufacturing sector, driving overall output expansion at the fastest rate in more than four years. Business confidence and hiring rebounded together, suggesting that the US third‑quarter growth rate could approach 3%, about twice the pace of the second quarter. However, supply‑chain disruptions from Middle‑East conflicts and energy‑price risks remain major threats to firms.

According to S&P Global's preliminary data released on Friday the 21st, the US composite Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) rose from 54.5 in July to 56.0 in August, the highest level since April 2022. A PMI above 50 signals expansion, while below 50 indicates contraction.

S&P Global Market Intelligence chief business economist Chris Williamson said US corporate activity is booming, with third‑quarter output growth now the fastest in over four years and August’s expansion momentum further strengthening.

Service‑sector activity surged, with the August services PMI jumping from 54.6 in July to 56.8, a 20‑month high and well above Reuters economists’ forecast of 54.0. Markets had expected service‑sector growth to slow as one‑off factors such as World Cup spending and the US 250th‑anniversary celebrations faded, but the sector actually accelerated.

New business growth in services was the fastest since December 2024, pushing related hiring to a 19‑month high. Overall, US firms’ hiring pace in August was the quickest since January 2025, with both manufacturing and services expanding staff, the latter showing especially strong performance.

S&P Global noted that current third‑quarter survey data suggest an annualised US growth rate close to 3%, a clear acceleration from the 1.5% seen in the second quarter. This also indicates that growth momentum is shifting from manufacturing in Q2 to services in Q3, raising reliance on consumer spending and financial‑service growth.

Williamson said employer confidence improved as concerns over tariffs and the Middle‑East conflict eased. The forward‑looking output‑expectation indicator rose to a nine‑month high, reflecting a more optimistic outlook for future operations.

Supply‑chain disruptions weighed on manufacturing. In contrast, the August manufacturing PMI fell from 53.9 in July to 53.2, a five‑month low and below the market’s 53.9 forecast, though it remained in expansion territory. Raw‑material shortages, shipping delays and firms cutting safety inventories all constrained factory output.

The Iran‑related war effectively closed the Hormuz Strait, disrupting key bulk‑commodity supplies and pushing energy prices higher. After the conflict erupted, firms initially stocked up, spurring a rapid rise in orders, but as safety‑stock needs waned, August order growth slowed for the fourth consecutive month and factory output growth fell to a 13‑month low.

The survey showed that August supply‑delay levels were still among the most severe in the past four years, clearly limiting many firms’ ability to raise production. Williamson warned that the Middle‑East situation remains a major concern, especially the impact of hostilities on supply routes and energy prices.

On the other hand, cost pressures eased in August, with input‑cost growth the slowest since the Iran war began, though input and selling‑price inflation remained elevated. Average cost growth in the third quarter so far is still slightly above the second‑quarter level, indicating that inflation risks have not vanished.

Williamson cautioned that while price pressures are gradually easing, a resurgence in energy prices could quickly reignite them. As the US economy shows stronger‑than‑expected resilience, its ability to sustain near‑3% growth will depend on whether service‑sector demand endures and whether Middle‑East conflict and supply‑chain bottlenecks worsen.

items.title: 美時與Alvotech簽署授權與商業化合作協議 於美國及亞洲市場推動兩項生物相似藥
items.title_en: MediTimes Signs Licensing and Commercialization Agreement with Alvotech to Advance Two Biosimilar Drugs in U.S. and Asian Markets
paras: 美時(1795-TW)今(21)日晚間召開重訊記者會，宣布與Alvotech(ALVO-US)簽署策略授權與商業化合作協議，將於美國及主要亞洲市場共同推動Imfinzi(durvalumab)及Hemlibra(emicizumab)生物相似藥候選藥物AVT34及AVT87 。
美時說明，Imfinzi是一款用於治療多種癌症的生物製劑，2025年全球銷售額約61億美元；Hemlibra則是一款用於A型血友病患者常規性預防治療，可預防或降低出血事件發生頻率的生物製劑，2025年全球銷售額約48億瑞士法郎，約58億美元。
美國方面，美時將透過既有商業團隊推動2項產品商業化，Alvotech則依非專屬協議，保留兩項產品於美國直接商業化的權利。另外，Alvotech將持續負責2項產品的開發、藥證取得與維護，並作為產品在協議中所有市場的獨家供應商。
亞洲部分，美時將取得8個市場的獨家商業化權利，包括南韓、台灣、泰國、越南、菲律賓、新加坡、香港及馬來西亞，並負責當地藥證申請。
總經理Petar Vazharov表示，此次合作結合Alvotech生物相似藥開發與製造能力、美時在美國及亞洲深厚的商業化經驗與市場基礎，將有效推動AVT34及AVT87未來在全球主要市場的商業化。此外，這2項候選藥物將進一步拓展美時生物相似藥產品在腫瘤及罕病領域的布局。
paras_en: MediTimes (1795‑TW) held a major press conference this evening (the 21st) to announce that it has signed a strategic licensing and commercialization agreement with Alvotech (ALVO‑US) to jointly promote the biosimilar candidates AVT34 and AVT87, modeled on Imfinzi (durvalumab) and Hemlibra (emicizumab), in the United States and key Asian markets.

MediTimes explained that Imfinzi is a biologic used to treat multiple cancers, with projected global sales of about $6.1 billion in 2025; Hemlibra is a biologic for routine prophylaxis in patients with hemophilia A, aimed at preventing or reducing bleeding events, with projected global sales of roughly CHF 48 billion (about $5.8 billion) in 2025.

In the United States, MediTimes will commercialize the two products through its existing sales team, while Alvotech, under a non‑exclusive arrangement, retains the right to commercialize the products directly in the U.S. Alvotech will continue to handle development, regulatory approval and maintenance for both products and will serve as the exclusive supplier for all markets covered by the agreement.

In Asia, MediTimes will obtain exclusive commercialization rights in eight markets—South Korea, Taiwan, Thailand, Vietnam, the Philippines, Singapore, Hong Kong and Malaysia—and will be responsible for local regulatory filings.

General Manager Petar Vazharov said the partnership combines Alvotech’s biosimilar development and manufacturing capabilities with MediTimes’ deep commercialization experience and market presence in the U.S. and Asia, which will effectively drive the global rollout of AVT34 and AVT87. He added that the two candidates will further expand MediTimes’ biosimilar portfolio in oncology and rare‑disease indications.

items.title: 美國揚言對伊朗發動經濟制裁 外資連買塑化股齊漲
items.title_en: U.S. Threatens Economic Sanctions on Iran, Foreign Investors Buy Plastics and Chemical Stocks, All Rise
paras: 近期美國川普揚言將對伊朗實施「史無前例的經濟戰與孤立」，引發國際油價飆升，市場憂心制裁升級將進一步擴大中東戰事衝擊國際油價周四(20日)大漲逾2%，在外資連買下，也激勵今(21)日低基期的塑化類股中石化(1314-TW)、台達化(1309-TW)收漲逾半根停板，塑化族群也多檔臉紅上揚，漲幅也超過2-4％。
據報載，美國可能對德黑蘭發動「前所未有規模的經濟戰爭與孤立」，並表示任何向伊朗提供援助的國家，都將面臨後果，美國財政部長貝森特也將於下周一(24日)召開記者會，詳細說明美國採取何種行動制裁。
根據今日盤後證交所統計資料顯示，外資已連6日買超中石化、連2日買超台達化，其他包括與油價、石化原料高度相關的概念股，外資也持續買進，外資連續2日買超的亞聚(1308-TW)漲4％、台塑化(6505-TW)、華夏(1305-TW)、台聚(1304-TW)、南亞(1303-TW)、台化(1326-TW)、台塑(1301-TW)等漲幅都來到2-4％，
法人表示，在美伊雙方外交談判未出現突破前，油價仍將維持高度波動，地緣政治風險溢價短期內也難以明顯消退，塑化股族群受油價上揚影響，尤其是目前股價基期較低的塑化股，在股價逐漸完成築底後，有機會再往上攻堅。
paras_en: Recently, U.S. President Trump threatened to launch an "unprecedented economic war and isolation" against Iran, sending international oil prices soaring. The market worries that an escalation of sanctions could further widen the Middle‑East conflict’s impact on oil, and oil jumped more than 2% on Thursday (the 20th). Foreign investors’ buying spurred the low‑base‑price plastics and chemicals stocks on the 21st, with Sinopec (1314‑TW) and Delta Chemical (1309‑TW) each gaining more than half a tick to the daily limit, while many other plastics‑chemical stocks also turned red, rising 2‑4%.

According to reports, the United States may launch a "war of unprecedented scale" of economic warfare and isolation against Tehran, warning that any country providing aid to Iran will face consequences. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen is set to hold a press conference on Monday the 24th to detail what actions the U.S. will take in sanctioning Iran.

Data from the Taiwan Stock Exchange after today’s trading show that foreign investors have bought more than the market for six consecutive days in Sinopec and for two consecutive days in Delta Chemical. Other stocks closely tied to oil prices and petrochemical feedstocks also saw continued foreign buying. Stocks that have been net bought for two days in a row – such as Asia Polymer (1308‑TW) up 4%, Formosa Plastics Corp. (6505‑TW), Hua‑Xia (1305‑TW), Taiwan Poly (1304‑TW), Nan Ya (1303‑TW), Taiwan Chemical (1326‑TW) and Formosa Plastics (1301‑TW) – all rose between 2‑4%.

Analysts say that until diplomatic talks between the U.S. and Iran produce a breakthrough, oil prices will remain highly volatile and the geopolitical risk premium will not dissipate quickly. The plastics‑chemical sector, buoyed by higher oil prices, especially those stocks that are currently at a low base, could see further upside as they complete bottom‑building and start to climb again.

items.title: 〈房產〉自用需求不弱 7月五大銀行新承做房貸衝上1年新高
paras: 中央銀行今(21)日公布7月五大銀行(台銀、合庫銀、土銀、華銀和一銀)新承做放款統計，新承做房貸較上月增加111.35億元至691.09億元，創去年8月以來單月高點，而房貸利率2.29%，月減0.009個百分點，則創去年7月以來新低。
央行說明，主要是因民眾申請新青安貸款，加上趕在農曆7月前交屋、買方集中在7月完成移轉登記，推升房貸需求，而新青安貸款占比達45.04%，創近4年半最高，也連動購屋貸款利率下滑，部分銀行對首購族給出較低的利率優惠。
不過，央行認為，五大銀行新承做房貸增加不解讀為整體房市景氣回溫，仍要持續觀察後市。
台灣房屋趨勢中心執行長張旭嵐指出，青安3.0新增排老、排富和總價門檻，使民眾趕在新規上路前，加快簽約申貸的步伐，加上近兩個月來股市高低震盪，部分高資產族群，趁機將股市部位獲利了解，將資金投入到穩定性相對高的中高價位不動產，同時，不少預售案趕在農曆7月前完工交屋、辦理過戶，多項因素使7月六都的買賣移轉量，繳出年月雙增的佳績。

items.title: Qnity首度以廠商亮相SEMICON Taiwan  9/2起展材料技術創新與整合專業
items.title_en: Qnity Debuts as Exhibitor at SEMICON Taiwan, Showcasing Material Innovation and Integration Expertise Starting Sept. 2
paras: 半導體價值鏈技術解決方案廠Qnity Electronics(Q-US)啟諾迪公司，將於下(9)月2日至4日在南港展覽館舉行的SEMICON Taiwan展出旗下產品組合，除了首次以參展廠商身分亮相外，Qnity將展示其涵蓋完整技術堆疊的材料創新與整合專業-從晶圓與元件層級再到先進封裝中的系統級整合，技術展示重點涵蓋先進半導體製造、先進封裝及熱管理解決方案。
Qnity半導體技術事業總裁 Kate Dei Cas表示，半導體創新的未來，取決於元件微縮與先進封裝的進步，為滿足下一代半導體技術的需求，整個產業生態系將需要更高層次的創新與合作，在SEMICON Taiwan期間，公司期待與客戶、合作夥伴及產業領袖共同探討未來的機會與挑戰。

Qnity已與涵蓋全球約80%半導體市場的企業建立合作夥伴關係，公司在去(2025)年淨銷售額約為47.5億美元，並於每年投入約7%的淨銷售額於研發。在台灣，Qnity啟諾迪亦持續深化在地佈局並貼近客戶需求，公司於今(2026)年稍早宣布，投資6,150萬美元於竹科打造先進半導體研發製造設施，進一步提升在地研發能量，並讓技術開發能力更加貼近客戶，此次透過技術論壇與產品展示，Qnity啟諾迪將展示推動下一世代半導體製造的關鍵技術，協助因應AI、高效能運算(HPC)及先進電子產品持續成長的需求。
此次Qnity啟諾迪執行長 Jon Kemp 將於9月2日上午11時在大師論壇發表題為「微縮到堆疊：重新定義埃米時代的半導體創新 」的主題演講，也參與此次半導體先進製程科技論壇、異質整合國際高峰論壇、策略材料高峰論壇以及TechxPOT創新技術發表會發表，主題涵蓋平坦化、金屬化、研磨液及先進封裝等領域進行技術發表。
paras_en: Semiconductor value‑chain technology solutions provider Qnity Electronics (Q‑US) – known as Qnity Inc. – will exhibit its product portfolio at SEMICON Taiwan, which runs from September 2‑4 at the Nangang Exhibition Center. In addition to appearing for the first time as an exhibitor, Qnity will showcase its end‑to‑end material innovation and integration capabilities—from wafer and device levels to system‑level integration in advanced packaging. The display will focus on advanced semiconductor manufacturing, advanced packaging, and thermal‑management solutions.

Qnity’s semiconductor technology business president, Kate Dei Cas, said that the future of semiconductor innovation depends on device miniaturization and advances in advanced packaging. To meet the demands of next‑generation semiconductor technologies, the entire industry ecosystem will need higher‑level innovation and collaboration. During SEMICON Taiwan, the company looks forward to discussing future opportunities and challenges with customers, partners, and industry leaders.

Qnity has established partnerships with companies that together cover roughly 80 % of the global semiconductor market. The firm posted net sales of about $4.75 billion in 2025 and invests roughly 7 % of net sales in R&D each year. In Taiwan, Qnity Inc. continues to deepen its local footprint and align with customer needs. Earlier this year, the company announced a $61.5 million investment in Hsinchu Science Park to build advanced semiconductor R&D and manufacturing facilities, boosting local R&D capacity and bringing technology development closer to customers. Through a technical forum and product showcase, Qnity will present key technologies that drive the next generation of semiconductor manufacturing, helping meet the growing demand from AI, high‑performance computing (HPC) and advanced electronic products.

Qnity’s CEO Jon Kemp will deliver a keynote titled “From Miniaturization to Stacking: Redefining Semiconductor Innovation in the Era of Moore’s Law” at 11 a.m. on September 2 during the Master Forum. He will also take part in the Advanced Process Technology Forum, the International Heterogeneous Integration Summit, the Strategic Materials Summit, and the TechxPOT Innovation Technology Presentation, covering topics such as planarization, metallization, polishing slurries, and advanced packaging.

items.title: 攻佔關西版圖！國發會與阪急阪神不動產簽MoU 鏈結台日「13+17」戰略產業
items.title_en: Seizing the Kansai Market! NDC and Hankyu Hanshin Real Estate Sign MoU to Link Taiwan-Japan “13+17” Strategic Industries
paras: 國發會主委葉俊顯率團前往日本，除了考察前瞻科技外，更全力推動台日新創落地與戰略產業交流。本次行程達成多項重大成果，包括國發會首次與關西指標企業「阪急阪神不動產」簽署合作備忘錄（MoU），促成該集團與台灣建立系統化平台，同時拜訪日本政策核心智庫「三菱綜合研究所」，借鏡日本2040年前公私部門投資370兆日元的戰略地圖，深化台灣13項戰略產業與日本17項關鍵領域的跨國鏈結。

本次國發會加強AI新十大建設「千億資金驅動創新」的國際合作，將資源精準聚焦於關東與關西兩大區域。與阪急阪神不動產簽署MoU後，將能有效協助台灣智慧城市等領域的新創團隊打入關西大型企業網絡。此外，國發會也在東京舉辦第五屆「台灣·日本創新高峰會」，串聯台、日、美三方創新生態系，協助46家人工智慧、半導體等深科技新創對接國際資源，並同步啟用「Startup Island TAIWAN」東京新基地，大幅提升服務量能，協助更多台灣新創拓展國際市場。
在戰略產業政策規劃方面，代表團特別參訪日本重要政策核心智庫「株式會社三菱綜合研究所」。三菱總研於會中分享，面對高齡少子化、經濟安全韌性與投資動能不足等結構性議題，日本政府規劃在2040年前由公私部門合計投資高達370兆日元，全力主攻AI、半導體與次世代通訊等17項關鍵戰略產業。
由於台日雙方正面臨極其相似的缺工與人口老齡化痛點，葉俊顯於會中深入研討日方17項關鍵產業的擇定邏輯，以及跨部門資源整合與權責協調機制，作為我國孵化13項戰略產業政策藍圖的重要借鏡。
葉俊顯表示，未來將推動台灣13項戰略產業與日本17項戰略領域強強聯手，充分發揮兩國產業優勢與互補量能，共同提升經濟安全韌性並創造雙贏。
paras_en: NDC Chairman Yeh Jun-hsien led a delegation to Japan, not only to explore forward‑looking technologies but also to vigorously promote the landing of Taiwan‑Japan startups and strategic industry exchanges. The trip yielded several major outcomes, including the NDC’s first MoU with Kansai flagship firm Hankyu Hanshin Real Estate, establishing a systematic platform between the group and Taiwan, as the delegation also visited the core policy think‑tank Mitsubishi Research Institute to learn from Japan’s pre‑2040 public‑private investment roadmap of ¥370 trillion, deepening cross‑border links between Taiwan’s 13 strategic industries and Japan’s 17 key sectors.

The NDC is strengthening international cooperation for its “Top‑10 AI New Infrastructure – Hundred‑Billion‑Dollar Funding to Drive Innovation,” focusing resources precisely on the Kanto and Kansai regions. After signing the MoU with Hankyu Hanshin Real Estate, it will be able to effectively help Taiwanese smart‑city startups enter large Kansai corporate networks. In addition, the NDC hosted the 5th Taiwan‑Japan Innovation Summit in Tokyo, connecting Taiwan, Japan and the United States’ innovation ecosystems, assisting 46 AI, semiconductor and other deep‑tech startups in linking with international resources, and simultaneously launching the “Startup Island TAIWAN” Tokyo hub to greatly expand service capacity and help more Taiwanese startups expand overseas markets.

Regarding strategic industry policy planning, the delegation specially visited the important Japanese policy think‑tank Mitsubishi Research Institute. Mitsubishi shared that, facing structural issues such as aging populations, economic‑security resilience and insufficient investment momentum, the Japanese government plans to invest up to ¥370 trillion from public and private sectors by 2040, fully targeting AI, semiconductors and next‑generation communications among 17 key strategic industries.

Because Taiwan and Japan are confronting very similar labor shortages and population aging challenges, Yeh Jun-hsien discussed in depth the Japanese logic for selecting the 17 key industries, as well as cross‑departmental resource integration and responsibility coordination mechanisms, using these insights as an important reference for shaping Taiwan’s policy blueprint to incubate 13 strategic industries.

Yeh Jun-hsien said that moving forward Taiwan’s 13 strategic industries will be strongly partnered with Japan’s 17 strategic sectors, fully leveraging the two countries’ industrial strengths and complementary capacities to jointly enhance economic‑security resilience and create a win‑win outcome.

items.title: 〈航運指數〉SCFI連4漲 船公司拚9月中旬漲價
paras: 上海航交所今(21)日公布最新一期上海出口集裝箱運價指數(SCFI)，呈現連4漲，來到3409.63點，續彈54.39點，漲幅1.62%，四大長程航線中，歐洲線續回跌整理，美國線則續漲，呈現漲跌互見，其中，遠東到美東每FEU達9700美元，有望持續上看1萬美元歷史高價區，不過，貨攬業者也提醒，9月中旬船公司能否漲價成功仍有待觀察。
本周主要航線中，遠東到歐洲每TEU下跌103美元至2842美元，跌3.5%；遠東到地中海每TEU跌162美元至3767美元，跌幅4.12%。
不過，遠東到美西每FEU(標準40呎櫃)運價續漲51美元至6765美元，彈升0.76%，遠東到美東每FEU續漲132美元，來到9700美元，漲幅1.38%。
貨攬業者指出， 地中海航運9 月上旬 FAK 指導價出爐，相較於8月下旬美西持平，美東調漲約 500美元，船公司持續展現漲價意圖，惟實際開盤價格能否有效執行，仍需觀察月底訂艙狀況和船舶裝載率變化。
貨櫃航商萬海(2615-TW)今日也在主管機關要求下公告7月自結數，單月稅後純益 60.84億元，年增19.97%，每股純益(EPS)達2.17元。
萬海表示，由於巴拿馬運河通行水位連續下降，以及亞洲颱風等氣候因素持續影響船期安排和港口作業效率，在新增運力成長有限的情況下，全球貨櫃航運市場供需結構仍維持健康。

items.title: 量子電腦結合超級電腦！台灣AI新十大建設赴日取經 打造跨國量子商業生態系
paras: 台灣「AI新十大建設」加速向國際插旗，為擴大政策效益與日本鏈結，國發會主委葉俊顯率團前進日本東京，拜訪量子人工智慧技術全球商業研發中心（G-QuAT）、富士通株式會社（Fujitsu）與日本電器株式會社（NEC）等產研頂尖機構。本次參訪重點聚焦於量子電腦、AI資料中心（AIDC）及Physical AI等前瞻領域，透過台日雙方技術與供應鏈的深厚合作基礎，為台灣AI產業政策與先進科技發展注入強勁的國際合作動能。

國發會代表團首先前進日本國家級量子基地、由產業總合研究所（AIST）成立的G-QuAT，實地考察量子電腦、量子運算實驗室及量子電路聯合實驗室。日方於會中分享量子科技在材料、製藥與氣象預測精確性等領域的商業應用，這與台灣交通部氣象署運用AI模型結合超級電腦精進氣象預測的發展方向高度一致。雙方期待未來能在量子電腦產業供應鏈及應用領域展開進一步交流，打造跨國量子商業化合作生態系，創造台日雙邊技術合作新契機。
在AI資料中心與算力網路建設方面，代表團參訪積極參與日本政府AI戰略政策的富士通。富士通分享透過全光網路技術連結全國各地AI資料中心的規劃，進而達到超高速傳輸、分散電量與抗災韌性的目標。
葉俊顯指出，此概念與我國AI新十大建設中的主權AI及全民智慧生活圈規劃方向不謀而合。富士通與台灣供應鏈過去已有長期緊密合作，未來雙方將進一步在全光網路、量子運算及高效能混合運算（HPC）等領域深化合作，攜手建構跨國AI智慧生活圈。
此外，針對AI應用落地與解決社會課題，代表團參訪在Physical AI與智慧防災領域具備強大研發能量的NEC。NEC目前積極與日本政府合作推動AI機器人與智慧政府，與台灣AI新十大建設的發展架構完全契機。葉俊顯強調，台日雙方同樣面對高齡少子化與自然災害等社會痛點，期待未來在AI新十大建設架構下，重點深化AI災防與機器人領域的研發鏈結，以創新科技力攜手克服挑戰。

items.title: 材料-KY營收動能持續回復中 上半年每股純益1.85元
paras: 材料-KY(4763-TW)營運動能下持續回復中，公司今(21)日公布最新獲利 資訊，2026年第二季稅後純益7.17億元，季減35.73%，年減57.92%，每股純益0.72元，2026年上半年稅後純益18.31億元，每股純益1.85元。
材料-KY在2026 年 7 月營收站穩 10 億元大關，達 10.59 億元，爲 2026 年單月新高，月增 4.5%，年增 32.05%，展現營運動能穩步回升；2026 年 1-7 月營收 66.13 億元，則年減 24.98%。公司表示，將持續強化成本控管、提升營運效率，並調整產品與市場布局，積極因應市場變化。
材料-KY2026年第二季營收27.43億元 ，毛利率40.89%，季減14.69個百分點，年減17.34個百分點，稅後純益7.17億元，季減35.73%，年減57.92%，每股純益0.72元。
材料-KY2026年上半年營收55.54億元，毛利率48.06%，年減10.28個百分點，2026年上半年稅後純益18.31億元，年減5.95%，每股純益1.85元。
材料-KY2026年第二季營收為28.43億元，較去年同期減少26.3%，較前季成長4.8%。主要受地緣政治及市場供需調整影響，部分客戶延後交貨並調整庫存水位。惟隨庫存逐步消化，下半年度需求可望回升。
材料-KY第二季毛利率為40.89%，毛利率下降主要受部分子公司4、5月進行年度歲修影響，本次歲修範圍較往年擴大，停機時間較長致產量減少，致本季單位成本上升。此外，市場供需調整影響產品售價，以及銷售組合的變動也使第二季毛利率短期承壓。
材料-KY2026年第二季稅後純益7.17億元，較去年同期及上 季減少。公司將持續推動成本優化與營運韌性提升計畫，以掌握下半年度市場需求回補機會，穩固在醋酸纖維產業的領先地位及核心獲利能力。
材料-KY指出，在產品布局方面，公司除持續深耕醋酸纖維絲束核心業務外，亦積極拓展高附加價值產品，包括加熱不燃燒菸（HNB）專用濾嘴絲束、口含菸（尼古丁袋）不織布材料及新型晶球（爆珠）濾嘴等新產品領域，以掌握新型菸草產品快速成長所帶來的市場機會。
此外，隨著中國大陸服飾用醋酸纖維需求持續增長，以及消費市場對環保與永續材料需求日益提升，材料-KY正規劃逐步擴增具低碳與環保優勢的醋酸纖維長絲（森綾）產能，並積極拓展亞洲、中東、非洲及拉丁美洲等新興市場，打造中長期營運成長新動能。
展望2026年下半年度，儘管中東與東南亞部分市場需求短期趨緩，加上客戶持續進行庫存調整，以及全球貿易爭端與產業供需變化帶來不確定性，材料-KY仍持續加強與客戶溝通交期排程，並持續拓展新興市場，暨同步強化營運資金與成本控管，以確保財務穩健。同時，材料-KY持續投資研發與推動循環經濟應用，專注於綠色與永續材料開發，展現長期成長與永續經營的決心。

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉美股止血反彈！道瓊漲逾500點 但高殖利率陰霾揮之不去 三大指數周線全黑
paras: 美股週五 (21 日) 全面翻紅，道瓊勁揚逾 500 點，標普 500 指數與那斯達克指數同步上漲約 0.43%。金融、醫療與原物料股領漲，加密貨幣概念股也在比特幣強彈帶動下飆升。不過，美債殖利率持續攀高，三大指數本週仍全數收黑。
醫療股成為週五推升道瓊的主要動力，Merck (MRK-US)、嬌生 (JNJ-US) 走高。金融股同步反彈，KBW 銀行指數上漲近 1%，摩根士丹利 (MS-US) 與花旗 (C-US) 表現突出；原物料類股則上漲約 2%，領漲標普 500 各大類股。
儘管週五反彈，三大指數仍難逃單週收黑。標普本週下跌 1.4%，創 7 月 17 日以來最大單週跌幅；那指累計下跌 2%，兩者均終止連續三週上漲。道瓊本週下跌約 0.9%，連續第二週收黑。
比特幣週五一度漲破 7.9 萬美元，單週大漲 22%，創 2024 年 11 月以來最佳單週表現。加密貨幣概念股全面噴出，Robinhood (HOOD-US) 狂飆近 14%，成為標普週五表現最佳成分股。
市場認為，美國財政部加碼長天期公債回購，帶來流動性增加的期待，加上美國總統川普敦促國會通過加密市場結構法案《Clarity Act》，共同推升比特幣行情。
然而，財政部的救市措施仍未能壓低長債殖利率。10 年期美債殖利率週五升至 4.737%，30 年期殖利率攀上 5.276%，均逼近十多年高點。
美國財長貝森特此前表示，財政部擁有因應美債市場波動的「大型工具箱」，不排除進一步擴大目前每檔至少 40 億美元的長債回購規模，並預告政府將加強財政整頓。
不過，市場認為，回購措施主要只能改善債券市場的交易流動性，難以化解通膨疑慮、龐大財政赤字、債券供給增加及期限溢價攀升等根本問題。
油價走高也進一步加深市場對通膨的擔憂。布蘭特原油週五上漲 0.7%，收在每桶 94.39 美元，連續第六個交易日走高。
黃金則受惠於財政疑慮升溫，紐約期金本週大漲 5.6%，收在每盎司 4,624.10 美元，連續第三週上漲，三週累計漲幅超過 14%。
市場下週將迎來多項關鍵事件。貝森特預定下週一公布財政部債券回購與財政整頓措施的更多細節；輝達 (NVDA-US) 將於下週三盤後公布財報，市場焦點將落在 AI 晶片需求及其規模達 5,000 億美元的融資計畫。
聯準會主席華許則將於下週五在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會發表演說，投資人將從中尋找利率走向、通膨前景及央行獨立性的最新線索。
美股週五 (21 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭漲跌互見。Meta (META-US) 上漲 0.75%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下跌 0.63%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 上漲 1.22%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 上漲 0.43%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 0.57%。
費城半導體族群互有消長。AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 0.81%；博通 (AVGO-US) 上漲 1.21%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 下跌 0.98%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 下跌 0.78%；高通 (QCOM-US) 微漲 0.01%；美光 (MU-US) 下跌 0.77%。
記憶體類股普遍收墨。美光 (MU-US) 跌 0.77%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 下滑 2.05%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 下跌 0.28%；希捷科技 (STX-US) 微跌 0.03%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 漲 0.20%。
台股 ADR 漲多跌少。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 微升 0.71%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 收平；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 1.89%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 微漲 0.05%。
企業新聞
莫德納 (MRNA-US) 漲幅高近 8.9% 至每股 145.13 美元，為標普週五表現第二佳成分股，合作夥伴Merck (MRK-US) 同步上漲超 2% 至每股 152.55 美元。莫德納本週稍早公布與Merck共同研發的個人化癌症疫苗取得正面試驗結果，股價一度飆升近 180%，週四隨後重挫 24%，週五則出現反彈。
特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 走高 5.14% 至每股362.86美元。該公司宣布，將在 9 月中旬於德國登場的 IAA Transportation 商用車展上，發表面向歐洲市場的純電動 Semi 卡車。
SpaceX (SPCX-US) 上漲 2.2%，收在每股 136.97 美元，未受第二波限售股解禁及華爾街首份「賣出」評級拖累。SpaceX 於 8 月 20 日迎來上市滿 70 天的階梯式解禁，此次釋出最多約 3.19 億股，同時，DZ Bank 以資本需求龐大、估值過高且存在「崩跌風險」為由，給予該股「賣出」評級及 100 美元目標價。
Marvell (MRVL-US) 重挫 5.57% 至每股 237.04 美元，成為標普最差成分股，但全週仍累計上漲逾 6%。Marvell 週三宣布向 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 旗下 Google 發行認股權證，Google 最多可購入 5,897 萬股 Marvell 普通股，相關持股價值最高可達 121.9 億美元。
阿里巴巴 ADR (BABA-US) 下殺 8.6% 至每股119.34 美元，回吐前一交易日漲幅。阿里巴巴公布的財報未達市場預期，儘管 AI 業務營收大幅成長，仍未能消除投資人對整體業績的疑慮。
華爾街分析
Verdence Capital Advisors創辦人暨執行長Leo Kelly警告，若美債殖利率持續攀升，加上中東緊張局勢延續，美股今年秋季可能進一步下跌，甚至進入修正區間。
Kelly表示，市場目前已適應10年期美債殖利率落在4%至5%，但若受到突發事件刺激，殖利率突破至6%至7%，情況就會變得棘手，股市也將做出負面反應。
Bernstein 分析師認為，美財政部擴大買回長期公債，可望增加市場資金並改善流動性，促使部分資金流入比特幣，成為本週幣價大漲的主要推力。過去經驗顯示，市場資金越充裕，比特幣通常越容易上漲。
不過，Muriel Siebert投資長Mark Malek指出，美債殖利率短暫回落後迅速反彈，顯示投資人更關注高殖利率背後的根本問題，而非財政部的回購操作。通膨前景不明、龐大財政赤字、公債供給增加及期限溢價上升，均難以單靠市場操作化解。
Plurimi Wealth投資長Patrick Armstrong則研判，貝森特試圖壓低長期殖利率的做法可能已產生反效果，迫使財政部採取更多行動。他直言，每當政府試圖控制30年期美債殖利率時，最後通常仍是市場占上風，除非由擁有龐大資產負債表的聯準會親自出手。
美銀策略師Michael Hartnett表示，如果財政部回購計畫無法壓低殖利率，美元可能承受壓力，投資人也可能在11月期中選舉前加碼放空風險資產，其中包括AI超大規模雲端服務商。高盛策略師也指出，避險基金已開始降低對波動劇烈的AI交易依賴，轉向其他投資領域。
數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主

items.title: 美國債務危機最快一年後爆發？達里歐喊賣債券、買黃金
items.title_en: US Debt Crisis Could Erupt as Soon as One Year? Dalio Urges Selling Bonds and Buying Gold
paras: 橋水基金創辦人、億萬富豪投資人達里歐(Ray Dalio)警告，美國債務危機最快可能在未來數年內爆發，投資人應降低債券配置，並將約10%至15%的投資組合配置於黃金，另外持有「少量」比特幣，以分散貨幣貶值與通膨風險。
達里歐周五(21日)在LinkedIn發文表示，投資人應分散投資於不同資產及財政狀況穩健的國家。他認為，減持債券並增加黃金與比特幣部位，不僅可能降低整體風險，也有機會提高投資報酬。
達里歐長期警告政府債務持續膨脹的危險。近期長天期美債殖利率升至多年高點，美國最大海外債權國日本也出售美債以支撐日元。為遏止債市賣壓，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)本周宣布擴大長天期美債回購，但目前僅帶來短暫支撐。
達里歐表示，近期發展符合他在《國家如何破產 大週期》(How Countries Go Broke: The Big Cycle)一書提出的債務循環架構。隨著政府償債成本上升，最終可能遭遇投資人需求不足，屆時政府只能接受更高利率，或由央行創造貨幣購買公債，代價則是貨幣貶值與通膨升溫。
他估計，美國政府今年收入約5.5兆美元，支出則達7.5兆美元，留下約2兆美元缺口。光是利息支出就接近1兆美元，另有約10兆美元債務需要再融資。
若政策方向不變，達里歐預測美國債務危機可能在「三年左右、上下相差兩年」內出現，換言之，風險期可能落在未來一至五年。他主張透過削減支出、增加稅收及降低利率，把目前約占國內生產毛額(GDP)6%的財政赤字降至3%。
達里歐指出，英國、中國與日本也面臨類似財政壓力，因此看好不由政府發行的貨幣型資產，包括黃金與比特幣。黃金周五升至5月以來最高，比特幣則突破7.7萬美元，可望寫下2023年以來最大單周漲幅。
paras_en: Bridgewater founder and billionaire investor Ray Dalio warned that a US debt crisis could materialize within the next few years, urging investors to cut bond exposure and allocate about 10%‑15% of their portfolios to gold, while holding a "small" amount of Bitcoin to hedge currency depreciation and inflation risk.

Dalio posted on LinkedIn on Friday (the 21st) that investors should diversify across assets and countries with sound fiscal positions. He believes reducing bond holdings and increasing positions in gold and Bitcoin could not only lower overall risk but also potentially boost returns.

Dalio has long warned about the danger of ever‑growing government debt. Recently, long‑term US Treasury yields have risen to multi‑year highs and Japan, the United States’ biggest overseas creditor, has been selling US debt to support the yen. To curb selling pressure in the bond market, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced an expansion of long‑term Treasury buybacks this week, which so far has provided only a brief lift.

Dalio said the latest developments fit the debt‑cycle framework he outlined in his book *How Countries Go Broke: The Big Cycle*. As government debt‑service costs rise, demand from investors may dry up, forcing governments to accept higher rates or rely on central banks to create money to buy sovereign bonds, at the cost of currency depreciation and higher inflation.

He estimates that the US government will collect roughly $5.5 trillion in revenue this year against $7.5 trillion in spending, leaving a gap of about $2 trillion. Interest payments alone approach $1 trillion, and about $10 trillion of debt will need to be refinanced.

If policy remains unchanged, Dalio predicts a US debt crisis could emerge in "around three years, give or take two years," meaning the risk window could fall within the next one to five years. He advocates cutting expenditures, raising taxes and lowering rates to bring the fiscal deficit, currently about 6% of GDP, down to roughly 3%.

Dalio noted that the UK, China and Japan face similar fiscal pressures, so he is bullish on currency‑type assets not issued by governments, such as gold and Bitcoin. Gold rose on Friday to its highest level since May, and Bitcoin broke the $77,000 mark, poised for its biggest weekly gain since 2023.

items.title: 長江存儲母公司申請上海科創板IPO 擬籌資49億美元
items.title_en: Yangtze Memory Holdings Parent Applies for Shanghai STAR Market IPO, Aiming to Raise $4.9 Billion
paras: 綜合外媒周五(21日)報導，中國NAND快閃記憶體大廠長江存儲(YMTC)的母公司長江存儲控股股份有限公司(CCSH Corporation,CCSH)，計劃透過上海科創板首次公開募股(IPO)籌資人民幣330億元(約49億美元)，上市申請已獲上海證券交易所受理。若順利完成，將成為科創板史上第三大IPO，僅次於長鑫存儲(CXMT)與中芯國際(00981-HK)。
根據招股書，CCSH預計發行19.8億至24.3億股新股，上市後估值約2,750億至3,300億元人民幣(約410億至490億美元)。中信證券與中信建投擔任共同保薦機構。
CCSH是此次上市主體，旗下全資子公司YMTC則是集團主要營運業務，貢獻超過90%營收。YMTC生產NAND快閃記憶體，廣泛應用於智慧型手機、固態硬碟、資料中心及企業伺服器。
公司表示，AI大規模應用正帶動龐大且長期的資料儲存需求，上市有助擴充先進產能、強化研發，並確保中國及全球市場供應穩定。330億元人民幣募資中，208億元將用於升級生產線，122億元投入新一代NAND晶片及高速儲存產品研發。
受惠雲端服務業者大舉興建AI資料中心，以及全球記憶體供應吃緊，YMTC業績快速成長。2026年第一季營收達470億元人民幣，接近去年同期的5倍；歸屬股東淨利達333.8億元，超越2025年全年142.1億元的兩倍。
YMTC工廠目前接近滿載，第一季NAND平均售價較2025年平均水準高出173%，毛利率也由去年的35.3%升至76.8%。公司引述TrendForce資料表示，第一季以銷售額與出貨量計算，YMTC已成為全球第三大、中國第一大NAND供應商。
YMTC的競爭對手包括三星電子、SK海力士(SKHY-US)、美光(MU-US)、鎧俠及SanDisk(SNDK-US)。在AI需求與供應吃緊支撐下，YMTC與CXMT的議價能力增強，部分產品對中國客戶的報價甚至高於南韓競爭對手。
不過，CCSH也警告地緣政治、出口管制及供應鏈中斷等風險。YMTC已於2022年被美國商務部列入實體清單，並被五角大廈列為中國軍事企業。為降低限制衝擊，公司正擴大採用中國製設備，並開發利用較舊製程工具的生產技術。
paras_en: According to foreign media reports on Friday (the 21st), Yangtze Memory Technologies Co. (YMTC), a major Chinese NAND flash memory manufacturer, plans to raise 33 billion yuan (about $4.9 billion) through an initial public offering on Shanghai’s STAR Market. The listing application has been accepted by the Shanghai Stock Exchange. If completed, it would become the third‑largest IPO in STAR Market history, behind CXMT and SMIC (00981‑HK).

The prospectus states that CCSH intends to issue between 1.98 billion and 2.43 billion new shares, valuing the company at roughly 275 billion to 330 billion yuan (about $41 billion to $49 billion) after listing. CITIC Securities and CITIC Construction Investment act as joint sponsors.

CCSH is the listed entity, while its wholly‑owned subsidiary YMTC conducts the group’s core operations, contributing more than 90 % of revenue. YMTC manufactures NAND flash memory used widely in smartphones, solid‑state drives, data centers and enterprise servers.

The company says massive, long‑term data‑storage demand driven by large‑scale AI applications underpins the IPO, which will help expand advanced capacity, strengthen R&D, and ensure stable supply for China and global markets. Of the 33 billion yuan raised, 20.8 billion will fund production‑line upgrades and 12.2 billion will be invested in next‑generation NAND chips and high‑speed storage product development.

Benefiting from cloud providers building AI data centers and tight global memory supply, YMTC’s performance has surged. In Q1 2026, revenue reached 47 billion yuan, nearly five times the same period last year, and net profit attributable to shareholders hit 33.38 billion yuan, more than double the full‑year 2025 figure of 14.21 billion yuan.

YMTC’s factory is now close to full capacity; the average NAND selling price in Q1 was 173 % higher than the 2025 average, and gross margin rose from 35.3 % last year to 76.8 %. Citing TrendForce data, the company says that based on sales and shipments in Q1, YMTC became the world’s third‑largest and China’s largest NAND supplier.

YMTC’s competitors include Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix (SKHY‑US), Micron (MU‑US), Kioxia and SanDisk (SNDK‑US). With AI demand and supply constraints, YMTC and CXMT have gained bargaining power, with some product quotes to Chinese customers even exceeding those of South Korean rivals.

However, CCSH warns of geopolitical risks, export controls and supply‑chain disruptions. YMTC was placed on the U.S. Commerce Department’s Entity List in 2022 and designated by the Pentagon as a Chinese military‑linked company. To mitigate restrictions, the firm is expanding the use of domestically‑made equipment and developing production techniques that rely on older‑process tools.

items.title: AI晶片不只拚效能！博通籌800億美元 與輝達展開資本軍備競賽
items.title_en: Broadcom Seeks $80 Billion Funding, Sparring with Nvidia in Capital Arms Race for AI Chips
paras: 博通(AVGO-US)正洽談籌措700億至800億美元債務資金，用於一項支援Anthropic等人工智慧(AI)公司的晶片融資計畫，顯示AI基礎設施建設所需資本規模持續膨脹。
《CNBC》記者David Faber日前證實，這筆融資預計分成高順位與低順位兩部分。可優先獲得償付的高順位債務規模約為450億美元，承擔較高風險的低順位債務則約為350億美元。不過，知情人士表示，最終金額仍可能調整。
《彭博》率先報導這項交易，並指出整體融資規模最高可能達到1,000億美元。黑石集團(BX-US)與阿波羅全球管理(APO-US)等投資機構，正在洽談參與這項大型融資案。
隨著AI模型規模擴大及運算工作負載增加，晶片製造商正尋求史無前例的資金，協助客戶興建資料中心、採購晶片並擴充運算能力。融資已逐漸成為晶片商爭取大型AI客戶及支撐未來訂單的重要工具。
博通今年6月宣布推出新的AI平台，計畫為Anthropic與OpenAI提供總計20吉瓦(GW)的運算能力。黑石與阿波羅當時主導首階段350億美元融資，此次洽談中的新交易則可能進一步擴大相關資金規模。
博通的融資布局也反映AI晶片產業的競爭已從產品效能延伸至資本支援。輝達(NVDA-US)本周在監管文件中表示，將提供最高1,050億美元資金，支持OpenAI在美國俄亥俄州興建新資料中心。
此前一周，輝達也宣布與六家大型資產管理公司合作，推動規模達5,000億美元的融資計畫，希望將AI運算基礎設施發展成新的資產類別。
在大型科技公司競相投入AI資料中心之際，博通若成功完成最高800億美元融資，將進一步提高其在AI晶片與基礎設施市場的競爭力。博通股價周五上漲逾1%。
paras_en: Broadcom (AVGO-US) is in talks to raise $70 billion to $80 billion in debt financing for a chip‑funding program that supports AI companies such as Anthropic, underscoring the ever‑growing capital needs of AI infrastructure construction.

CNBC reporter David Faber confirmed that the financing is expected to be split into senior and junior tranches. The senior debt, which would be repaid first, is about $45 billion, while the riskier junior debt is roughly $35 billion, though sources say the final amounts could still be adjusted.

Bloomberg broke the story, noting that the total financing could top $100 billion. Investment firms including Blackstone (BX-US) and Apollo Global Management (APO-US) are in discussions to take part in the massive deal.

As AI models grow larger and computational workloads increase, chip makers are seeking unprecedented funding to help customers build data centers, purchase chips and expand compute capacity. Financing is becoming a key tool for chip firms to win large AI customers and support future orders.

Broadcom announced in June that it would launch a new AI platform, planning to provide a total of 20 GW of compute power to Anthropic and OpenAI. Blackstone and Apollo led the initial $35 billion financing round, and the new deal under negotiation could further expand that pool of capital.

Broadcom’s financing strategy also reflects that competition in the AI‑chip industry has moved beyond product performance to capital support. Nvidia (NVDA-US) this week disclosed in regulatory filings that it will provide up to $105 billion in funding to back OpenAI’s new data center in Ohio, USA.
A week earlier, Nvidia announced a partnership with six large asset‑management firms to launch a $500 billion financing program, aiming to turn AI compute infrastructure into a new asset class.

With major tech firms racing to pour money into AI data centers, if Broadcom successfully completes a financing of up to $80 billion, it will further boost its competitiveness in the AI‑chip and infrastructure market. Broadcom’s shares rose more than 1 % on Friday.

items.title: 貝森特愈來愈像川普！美債市場的耐心快沒了
items.title_en: Bessent Is Becoming More Like Trump! Patience in the U.S. Bond Market Is Running Out
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)曾表示，自己的職責是擔任美國公債市場的「首要守護者」。然而，一篇評論指出，財長真正的權力與價值來自金融市場，尤其是美債市場對他的信任，而貝森特恐怕難以長期同時維持市場信譽，又滿足總統川普的政治需求。
隨著經濟目標逐漸偏離現實，貝森特近期不僅更頻繁為川普政策辯護，說話方式也愈來愈像川普。這可能侵蝕財長最重要的資產，也就是在投資人眼中的可信度。

財長最重要的資產是市場信任

評論作者回憶，自己曾於2008年至2009年金融危機期間在財政部任職，首次參加時任財長鮑爾森(Hank Paulson)主持的高階主管會議，是在貝爾斯登倒閉一周後。當時金融市場正處於近百年來最混亂的時刻之一。
作者指出，鮑爾森主持會議時，幾乎無法從發言辨別哪些人是政治任命官員，哪些人是常任文官。當一名官員試圖為住房可負擔修正計畫成效不彰進行政治包裝時，鮑爾森立即打斷對方，強調政治訊息可以稍後再談，當務之急是找出改善政策的方法。
鮑爾森並非毫無缺點，也帶有前高盛執行長特有的自信與偏見，但他大致成功維持市場信任，關鍵在於盡量避開黨派政治，並坦白向政府與公眾說明當時金融體系面臨的危險處境。
貝森特上任時同樣抱持遠大目標，提出所謂「3-3-3計畫」，希望將美國國內生產毛額(GDP)成長率推升至3%、把財政赤字降至GDP的3%，並讓國內石油日產量增加300萬桶。
他還主張將10年期美債殖利率壓低至3%，認為相較於聯準會(Fed)的聯邦基金利率，10年期殖利率對一般美國民眾的房貸及其他借貸成本更為重要。

三個三計畫逐漸偏離現實

然而，評論指出，貝森特和許多前任官員一樣，上任後才發現公共服務往往無法按照個人議程推進，而是必須不斷處理由外部事件引發的危機。貝森特面對的挑戰包括川普「解放日」關稅、伊朗戰爭，以及美國公債市場接連遭到拋售。
目前最新GDP年化成長率僅1.5%，財政赤字反而升至GDP的5.8%，石油日產量也只增加35萬桶，遠低於300萬桶目標。10年期美債殖利率則升至4.7%，甚至高於川普就職當天水準。
面對這些落差，貝森特並未向市場坦承政策目標面臨的困難，反而愈來愈採用川普式的政治語言。他多次否認關稅會推高通膨，並把相關批評稱為「關稅精神錯亂症」。
貝森特5月舉行記者會時，也曾把記者對生活成本上升及家庭儲蓄率下滑的擔憂，斥為過度悲觀的觀點。他當時預測財政赤字不久後將下降，並宣稱美伊協議即將達成，通膨與汽油價格也會隨之回落，但將近三個月後，相關協議仍未出現明顯進展。
儘管如此，貝森特近期仍進一步升高對伊朗的強硬措辭。他接受Newsmax訪問時表示，美國已從軍事上的「史詩怒火」轉向「經濟怒火」，將採取史無前例的措施孤立伊朗。他也開始在社群媒體與記者公開爭論，風格愈來愈接近川普。
人事動盪同樣加深外界疑慮。據新聞網站Notus報導，貝森特麾下16名經參議院確認的官員已有7人離職，幕僚長至少更換三次。雖然川普第二任政府整體人員流動率本就偏高，但財政部接連流失高階官員，仍可能影響政策執行與內部穩定。

迎合川普恐讓貝森特失去債市

評論認為，貝森特從來不會是一位傳統型財長，就像川普並非傳統型總統。貝森特表現最好時，仍像一名擅長掌握市場機會的總體經濟交易員，例如近期干預匯市以支撐日元，以及將每次長天期美債回購規模提高一倍至40億美元。
然而，在最糟的情況下，他看起來更像替政府政策宣傳的政治代理人，甚至成為一名主導金融戰爭的財政部長，與國防部長赫格塞斯(Pete Hegseth)分別掌管經濟與軍事戰線。
目前貝森特的職位仍相對安全，原因是川普往往以主要股價指數衡量經濟表現，而受到AI相關投資推動，美股持續改寫歷史高點。但股市創高，不代表美債投資人會無限期接受他的政策。
30年期美債殖利率本周升至2007年以來高點，顯示投資人的耐心正在消退。財政部雖可透過回購及調整發債結構短暫影響市場，卻難以消除財政赤字、通膨與政策不確定性帶來的長期壓力。
評論警告，隨著債市持續考驗貝森特，而他為了維持川普信任又不斷模仿總統的政治語言，市場可能愈來愈質疑他是否仍會優先維護財政紀律與美債市場穩定。
貝森特面臨的真正兩難，不只是如何壓低殖利率，而是能否在忠於川普與忠於市場現實之間維持平衡。一旦為了保住政治地位而犧牲市場信任，他失去的將是財長最重要、也最難重新建立的信用。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has said his job is to serve as the "primary guardian" of the U.S. Treasury market. However, a commentary notes that the secretary’s real power and value come from the financial markets, especially the bond market’s trust in him, and Bessent may find it difficult to maintain market credibility over the long term while also satisfying President Trump’s political demands.

As economic targets drift further from reality, Bessent has lately defended Trump’s policies more frequently and his speaking style is increasingly reminiscent of Trump’s. This could erode the secretary’s most important asset – his credibility in the eyes of investors.

The secretary’s most important asset is market trust. The commentary’s author recalls working at the Treasury during the 2008‑2009 financial crisis and attending a senior‑official meeting chaired by then‑Treasury Secretary Hank Paulson a week after the collapse of Bear Stearns. At that time the financial markets were experiencing one of the most chaotic periods in a century.

The author points out that when Paulson chaired the meeting, it was almost impossible to tell from the speakers who were political appointees and who were career civil servants. When an official tried to spin the weak performance of the affordable‑housing repair program as a political success, Paulson cut him off immediately, stressing that political messaging could wait – the priority was to find ways to improve the policy.

Paulson was not without flaws and carried the confidence and bias typical of a former Goldman Sachs CEO, but he largely succeeded in preserving market trust by steering clear of partisan politics and being frank with the government and the public about the dangerous state of the financial system at the time.

When Bessent took office he also set ambitious goals, unveiling a so‑called "3‑3‑3 plan" that aimed to raise U.S. GDP growth to 3%, cut the fiscal deficit to 3% of GDP, and increase domestic oil production by 3 million barrels per day.

He also advocated pushing the 10‑year Treasury yield down to 3%, arguing that, compared with the Federal Reserve’s federal funds rate, the 10‑year yield matters more to ordinary Americans’ mortgage and other borrowing costs.

The three‑three‑three plan drifts further from reality. The commentary notes that, like many of his predecessors, Bessent discovered after taking office that public services rarely move forward according to a personal agenda and instead require constant crisis management triggered by external events. His challenges include Trump’s “day of liberation” tariffs, the war with Iran, and a series of sell‑offs in the U.S. Treasury market.

The latest annualized GDP growth is only 1.5%, the fiscal deficit has risen to 5.8% of GDP, and oil production has increased by just 350,000 barrels per day – far short of the 3 million‑barrel target. The 10‑year Treasury yield has climbed to 4.7%, even higher than the level on Trump’s inauguration day.

Facing these gaps, Bessent has not admitted to the market that the policy goals are difficult to achieve; instead he has increasingly adopted Trump‑style political rhetoric. He repeatedly denied that tariffs would push up inflation and dismissed related criticism as "tariff‑spirit psychosis."

At a press conference in May, Bessent brushed off reporters’ concerns about rising living costs and falling household savings rates as overly pessimistic. He predicted the fiscal deficit would soon decline, claimed a U.S.–Iran agreement was imminent, and said inflation and gasoline prices would fall accordingly – yet almost three months later the agreement showed no clear progress.

Nevertheless, Bessent has recently escalated his hard‑line language toward Iran. In a Newsmax interview he said the United States has shifted from an "epic fire of war" to an "economic fire" and will take unprecedented measures to isolate Iran. He has also begun publicly debating journalists on social media, with a style that increasingly mirrors Trump’s.

Personnel turmoil has deepened external doubts. According to the news site Notus, seven of the 16 Senate‑confirmed officials under Bessent have left, and the chief of staff has been replaced at least three times. While turnover was already high in Trump’s second administration, the Treasury’s loss of senior staff could still affect policy implementation and internal stability.

Catering to Trump may cost Bessent the bond market. The commentary argues that Bessent will never be a traditional treasury secretary, just as Trump is not a traditional president. At his best, Bessent resembles a macro‑economics trader who knows how to seize market opportunities, such as recent interventions in the foreign‑exchange market to support the yen and doubling each long‑term Treasury repurchase operation to $40 billion.

In the worst case, however, he looks more like a political propagandist for government policy, even becoming a finance minister who leads a financial war, while Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth runs the military front.

Bessent’s position remains relatively safe for now because Trump tends to judge economic performance by major stock‑price indices, and AI‑driven investment has kept U.S. equities climbing to new highs. But a soaring stock market does not mean Treasury investors will indefinitely accept his policies.

The 30‑year Treasury yield rose this week to its highest level since 2007, indicating that investors’ patience is waning. The Treasury can temporarily influence the market through repurchases and adjustments to issuance structure, but it cannot eliminate the long‑term pressure from deficits, inflation and policy uncertainty.

The commentary warns that as the bond market continues to test Bessent, and he keeps mimicking the president’s political language to retain Trump’s trust, the market may increasingly doubt whether he will still prioritize fiscal discipline and Treasury market stability.

Bessent’s real dilemma is not just how to push yields lower, but whether he can balance loyalty to Trump with loyalty to market reality. If he sacrifices market trust to preserve his political standing, he will lose the most important, and hardest‑to‑regain, component of a treasury secretary’s credibility.

items.title: 美股還能再漲6%！瑞銀喊標普500年底攻上8100點
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Could Rise Another 6% — UBS Raises S&P 500 Year‑End Target to 8,100 Points
paras: 瑞銀集團(UBS-US)旗下瑞銀全球財富管理(UBS Global Wealth Management)上調標普500指數目標，預估該指數今年底將升至8,100點，理由是企業獲利前景增強，且明年利潤可望持續成長。
最新目標較標普500指數周四收盤的7,641.16點高出約6%。瑞銀也將2027年年中目標由8,200點調升至8,400點，成為愈來愈多預測標普500指數將在2026年底突破8,000點的全球研究機構之一。
瑞銀維持對美股「具吸引力」的看法，並表示支撐這波多頭市場的三大支柱仍然穩固，包括經濟成長展現韌性、貨幣政策提供支持，以及人工智慧(AI)加速普及。
瑞銀指出，AI相關企業仍是推動市場上漲的重要力量，但近期行情也受到經濟中景氣循環產業條件改善的支撐，顯示漲勢正逐步擴展至科技股以外的領域。
隨著企業獲利展望轉強，瑞銀將標普500指數2026年每股盈餘(EPS)預估由335美元上調至350美元，2027年預估則由375美元提高至400美元。
這項調整顯示，瑞銀認為美股即使已處於高檔，仍有進一步上漲空間。只要經濟維持成長、政策環境保持有利，且AI投資繼續轉化為企業獲利，標普500指數年底仍可能挑戰8,100點。
paras_en: UBS Group (UBS‑US) through its UBS Global Wealth Management unit raised its S&P 500 target, forecasting the index will climb to 8,100 points by year‑end, citing stronger corporate earnings outlooks and the expectation of continued profit growth into next year.

The new target is about 6% higher than the S&P 500’s Thursday close of 7,641.16 points. UBS also lifted its mid‑2027 target from 8,200 to 8,400 points, joining an increasing number of global research firms that see the index breaking the 8,000‑point mark by the end of 2026.

UBS maintained its view that U.S. equities remain attractive, noting that the three main pillars supporting the current bull market remain solid: resilient economic growth, supportive monetary policy, and the accelerating adoption of artificial intelligence (AI).

The bank highlighted that AI‑related companies continue to be a key driver of market gains, but recent rallies have also been bolstered by improving conditions in cyclical sectors, indicating that the uptrend is extending beyond tech stocks.
With corporate profit outlooks strengthening, UBS raised its 2026 S&P 500 earnings‑per‑share (EPS) estimate from $335 to $350 and its 2027 estimate from $375 to $400.

The adjustment shows UBS believes the U.S. market, even at elevated levels, still has upside. As long as the economy keeps growing, policy conditions stay favorable, and AI investments keep translating into corporate profits, the S&P 500 could still challenge the 8,100‑point mark by year‑end.

items.title: 演算法停權惹禍！荷蘭認定Uber侵犯駕駛權益 重罰9.66億美元
items.title_en: Algorithmic Bans Cause Trouble! Netherlands Finds Uber Violated Drivers' Rights, Fines €825 million (≈$966 million)
paras: 荷蘭資料保護局(AP)認定，叫車平台Uber(UBER-US)在未充分告知駕駛的情況下，透過自動化系統停用其帳號，違反歐洲《一般資料保護規則》(GDPR)，決定對公司開罰8.25億歐元(約9.66億美元)。Uber不服裁決，表示將提出上訴。
根據《路透》看到的8月17日裁決文件，這將是GDPR上路以來第二高額罰款，僅次於愛爾蘭監管機關2023年對Meta(META-US)開出的12億歐元罰款。Meta當時因非法將歐洲Facebook用戶資料傳送至美國遭到處分，目前也在上訴。
GDPR禁止企業完全依靠電腦演算法，作出對個人生活具有重大影響的決定，相關程序必須納入具有實質意義的人工審查，並提供當事人提出異議的管道。
荷蘭資料保護局表示，Uber侵犯駕駛不受重大自動化決策影響的權利，同時未盡到充分告知義務。監管機關認為違規情節嚴重，因此決定開出高額罰款。
此案涉及2020至2022年發生在歐洲的事件，最初源自法國提出的申訴。由於Uber歐洲總部位於荷蘭，因此案件交由荷蘭資料保護局處理。
Uber的系統曾暫時停用部分涉嫌詐欺的駕駛帳號，例如系統判定駕駛刻意繞路以墊高車資，或接單後並無完成行程的意圖。荷蘭資料保護局也指稱，部分顧客評分偏低的駕駛曾遭電腦系統永久停權。
Uber否認曾以自動化方式永久停用駕駛帳號，強調相關暫停措施通常時間短暫，永久停權前一定會經過人工審查。公司發言人表示，Uber高度重視駕駛權益，目前政策也包含人工複核及申訴機制。
Uber批評裁決內容與罰款金額不成比例，並指出受影響人數相當有限，2021年歐洲僅有126名駕駛因顧客評分偏低遭停權。
近年歐洲監管機關依據隱私、競爭及數位市場規範，對Meta、Google(GOOGL-US)、蘋果(AAPL-US)及亞馬遜(AMZN-US)等美國科技巨頭開出數十億歐元罰款，但不少處分在多年上訴後遭到調降或撤銷。美國總統川普也曾批評相關罰款，美國國務院高層4月更將其形容為美歐經濟關係「最大的單一摩擦來源」。
paras_en: The Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) has determined that ride‑hailing platform Uber (UBER‑US) disabled drivers' accounts via an automated system without adequately informing the drivers, violating the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). The regulator has imposed a fine of €825 million (about $966 million) on the company. Uber disagrees with the ruling and says it will appeal.

According to a decision document seen by Reuters dated August 17, this is the second‑largest GDPR fine ever imposed, second only to the €1.2 billion penalty levied by Irish regulators on Meta (META‑US) in 2023 for illegally transferring European Facebook user data to the United States. Meta is also appealing that fine.

The GDPR prohibits companies from making decisions that have a significant impact on individuals' lives solely by computer algorithms; such processes must include substantive human review and provide a way for affected persons to lodge objections.

The Dutch authority said Uber infringed drivers' rights not to be subject to major automated decisions and also failed to provide sufficient notice. The regulator deemed the breach serious enough to warrant a hefty fine.

The case concerns incidents that occurred in Europe between 2020 and 2022 and originated from a complaint filed in France. Because Uber’s European headquarters are in the Netherlands, the matter was handled by the Dutch Data Protection Authority.

Uber’s system had temporarily disabled some driver accounts suspected of fraud, such as when the system judged a driver of deliberately taking longer routes to inflate fares or accepting rides without intending to complete them. The Dutch authority also alleged that drivers with consistently low customer ratings were permanently banned by the computer system.

Uber denies that it ever permanently disabled driver accounts automatically, stressing that any suspensions are usually brief and that permanent bans are always preceded by human review. A company spokesperson said Uber places a high priority on driver rights and that its policies now include manual re‑checks and an appeals mechanism.

Uber criticized the decision as disproportionate to the fine amount and pointed out that the number of affected drivers was relatively small—only 126 drivers in Europe were suspended in 2021 due to low customer ratings.

In recent years European regulators, invoking privacy, competition and digital market rules, have levied billions of euros in fines on U.S. tech giants such as Meta, Google (GOOGL‑US), Apple (AAPL‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US). Many of those penalties have been reduced or overturned after lengthy appeals. Former U.S. President Trump also criticized the fines, and senior U.S. State Department officials in April described them as the "largest single source of friction" in U.S.–EU economic relations.

items.title: 衰退擔憂降溫！美國8月商業活動創逾四年最快 Q3經濟成長率上看3%
items.title_en: Recession Fears Cool! US August Business Activity Hits Fastest Pace in Over Four Years, Q3 Growth Seen Near 3%
paras: 美國8月商業活動意外加速，服務業強勁成長抵銷製造業降溫，帶動整體產出擴張速度創逾四年新高。企業信心與招聘活動同步回升，顯示美國第三季經濟成長率可能接近3%，約為第二季的兩倍。不過，中東戰事造成的供應鏈中斷與能源價格風險，仍是企業面臨的主要威脅。
根據標普全球(S&P Global)周五(21日)公布的初值，8月美國綜合採購經理人指數(PMI)由7月的54.5升至56.0，創2022年4月以來最高。PMI高於50代表經濟活動擴張，低於50則表示萎縮。
標普全球市場財智首席商業經濟學家Chris Williamson表示，美國企業活動正在蓬勃發展，第三季迄今產出成長速度為逾四年最快，且8月擴張動能進一步增強。

服務業意外加速撐起第三季成長

8月服務業PMI由7月的54.6大幅升至56.8，創20個月新高，遠優於《路透》調查經濟學家預估的54.0。市場原本預期，隨著世界盃相關消費及美國獨立250周年慶祝活動等一次性因素消退，服務業成長將有所放緩，結果實際表現反而加速。
服務業新業務成長速度創2024年12月以來最快，帶動相關企業招聘增幅升至19個月新高。整體而言，美國企業8月增聘人力的速度為2025年1月以來最快，製造業與服務業均擴大招聘，但服務業表現尤其強勁。
標普全球指出，目前第三季調查數據顯示，美國經濟年化成長率有望接近3%，較第二季的1.5%明顯加速。這也顯示美國經濟成長動能已由第二季的製造業逐漸轉向服務業，對消費支出及金融服務成長的依賴程度隨之提高。
Williamson表示，隨著企業對關稅及中東衝突負面影響的擔憂減退，雇主信心有所改善。衡量企業未來產出預期的指標也攀升至九個月高點，反映企業對後續營運前景轉趨樂觀。

供應鏈干擾拖累製造業表現

相較之下，8月製造業PMI由7月的53.9降至53.2，創五個月新低，也低於市場預期的53.9，但仍維持在擴張區間。原料短缺、供應鏈延誤及企業減少建立安全庫存，均限制工廠生產。
伊朗戰爭導致荷姆茲海峽實質封閉，干擾重要大宗商品供應並推高能源價格。企業在戰爭爆發後一度積極增加庫存，帶動訂單快速上升，但隨著安全庫存需求減弱，8月訂單成長已連續第四個月放緩，工廠產出增速也降至13個月最低。
調查顯示，8月供應延誤程度仍接近過去四年最嚴重水準之一，明顯限制許多企業提高產量。Williamson指出，中東局勢仍是企業的重要憂慮，尤其是戰事對供應路線與能源價格的衝擊。
另一方面，企業成本壓力在8月有所緩解，投入成本增幅為伊朗戰爭爆發以來最慢，但投入價格與銷售價格漲幅仍處於高檔。第三季迄今平均成本增幅仍略高於第二季，意味通膨風險尚未消失。
Williamson警告，目前價格壓力雖逐漸減弱，但仍可能因能源價格再次上漲而迅速升溫。美國經濟展現比預期更強的韌性之際，後續能否維持接近3%的成長速度，仍取決於服務業需求能否延續，以及中東戰事與供應鏈瓶頸是否進一步惡化。
paras_en: US August business activity unexpectedly accelerated, with strong service‑sector growth offsetting a cooling manufacturing sector, driving overall output expansion at the fastest rate in more than four years. Business confidence and hiring rebounded together, suggesting that the US third‑quarter growth rate could approach 3%, about twice the pace of the second quarter. However, supply‑chain disruptions from Middle‑East conflicts and energy‑price risks remain major threats to firms.

According to S&P Global's preliminary data released on Friday the 21st, the US composite Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) rose from 54.5 in July to 56.0 in August, the highest level since April 2022. A PMI above 50 signals expansion, while below 50 indicates contraction.

S&P Global Market Intelligence chief business economist Chris Williamson said US corporate activity is booming, with third‑quarter output growth now the fastest in over four years and August’s expansion momentum further strengthening.

Service‑sector activity surged, with the August services PMI jumping from 54.6 in July to 56.8, a 20‑month high and well above Reuters economists’ forecast of 54.0. Markets had expected service‑sector growth to slow as one‑off factors such as World Cup spending and the US 250th‑anniversary celebrations faded, but the sector actually accelerated.

New business growth in services was the fastest since December 2024, pushing related hiring to a 19‑month high. Overall, US firms’ hiring pace in August was the quickest since January 2025, with both manufacturing and services expanding staff, the latter showing especially strong performance.

S&P Global noted that current third‑quarter survey data suggest an annualised US growth rate close to 3%, a clear acceleration from the 1.5% seen in the second quarter. This also indicates that growth momentum is shifting from manufacturing in Q2 to services in Q3, raising reliance on consumer spending and financial‑service growth.

Williamson said employer confidence improved as concerns over tariffs and the Middle‑East conflict eased. The forward‑looking output‑expectation indicator rose to a nine‑month high, reflecting a more optimistic outlook for future operations.

Supply‑chain disruptions weighed on manufacturing. In contrast, the August manufacturing PMI fell from 53.9 in July to 53.2, a five‑month low and below the market’s 53.9 forecast, though it remained in expansion territory. Raw‑material shortages, shipping delays and firms cutting safety inventories all constrained factory output.

The Iran‑related war effectively closed the Hormuz Strait, disrupting key bulk‑commodity supplies and pushing energy prices higher. After the conflict erupted, firms initially stocked up, spurring a rapid rise in orders, but as safety‑stock needs waned, August order growth slowed for the fourth consecutive month and factory output growth fell to a 13‑month low.

The survey showed that August supply‑delay levels were still among the most severe in the past four years, clearly limiting many firms’ ability to raise production.
